item.title: Kim Min-seok: "A party leader 200% in sync with the president is necessary… The previous way won't work" (김민석 “대통령과 합 200% 맞는 당대표 필요…그동안 방식 안 돼”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, former prime minister and candidate in the Democratic Party of Korea's leadership election, stated, "We need to elect a new leadership through this party convention, but when I think about whether it’s better to continue with the same method of leadership, direction, and line as before, my answer is no. It would be good to have 100% or 200% alignment with the president." (더불어민주당 당 대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 전 국무총리가 “이번 전당대회를 통해 새 지도부를 뽑아야 하는데, 그동안 했던 지도부와 지도력과 지도 노선의 방식으로 계속 가는 것이 더 나을까 (생각했을 때) 저는 아닌 것 같다”며 “대통령과 합이 100%, 200% 맞는 것이 좋다”고 말했다.)

The former prime minister made these remarks on the morning of the 10th while visiting the Democratic Party's Jeonju-gap district committee. He said, "Over the past year, the People Power Party, which had been unable to keep up at all, has now surpassed us, with some polls showing them winning by 1 or 2 percentage points. We need to seriously consider whether we can confidently maintain our current seats and win the next general election." (김 전 총리는 10일 오전 민주당 전주갑 지역위원회를 방문해 이렇게 말했다. 김 전 총리는 “지난 1년 동안 아예 쫓아오지도 못하던 국민의힘이 쫓아오는 걸 넘어서 일부 조사에서는 1%포인트, 2%포인트씩 이겨버리는 결과가 나오고 있다”며 “내일모레 총선을 치르면 우리가 자신 있게 현재 의석을 유지해 총선에 승리할 수 있을지를 심각하게 생각해봐야 한다”고 했다.)

Kim further stated, "If we become the ruling party, we must expand our base through alliances, integration, or recruitment. We need to show the public that we are still the dominant force, that the Lee Jae-myung government is unshaken and attracting talented people from all over. Only then can the government move forward without being shaken." He added, "I believe I am the best person to change the party's direction and work in that manner." (김 전 총리는 “여당이 됐으면 연대든, 통합이든, 영입이든 살을 찌워나가야 한다”며 “국민들이 볼 때 ‘아 저기가 여전히 대세구나’, ‘이재명 정부가 흔들리지 않고 천하의 인재들이 모여들고 있구나’ 하는 것을 보여줘야 한다. 그래야 정부가 흔들리지 않고 갈 수 있다”고 했다. 이어 “저는 그런 방식으로 당의 방향을 바꿔서 일을 해나가는 것을 제가 제일 잘할 수 있을 것 같다”고 했다.)

The former prime minister said, "The party needs to change to the point where it can compete in speed with the government. Over the past year, the party's focus and interests have been too narrow, but since we've mostly set our direction in that year, we need to truly sprint ahead." (김 전 총리는 “정부와 속도 경쟁을 하는 정도로 당이 바뀌어야 된다고 본다”며 “당이 지난 1년 동안 관심을 갖고 집중하는 주제가 너무 국한돼있었는데 1년 동안 거의 방향을 잡았기 때문에 진짜 속도전으로 뛰어야 한다”고 했다.)

On the same morning, Kim visited the Jeonbuk Provincial Office and held a meeting with Governor Lee Won-taek. (이날 오전 김 전 총리는 전북도청을 방문해 이원택 도지사와 면담을 하기도 했다.)

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok's "self-serving politics" vs. Jeong Cheong-rae's "I never left the party" — a repeat of mutual check (김민석 “자기 정치”-정청래 “당 떠난 적 없다”…견제 되풀이)
item.description:
Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, expected to face off at the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention, met in Jeonju, North Jeolla Province on the 10th and continued their war of nerves. Former Prime Minister Kim took a direct shot at former Representative Jeong in front of him, saying, "Now is not the time for self-serving politics," while former Representative Jeong highlighted Kim's past defection from the Democratic Party, stating, "I have never left the party even once and have dedicated myself to it." (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회에서 맞붙을 것으로 예상되는 김민석 전 국무총리와 정청래 전 대표가 10일 전북 전주에서 만나 신경전을 이어갔다. 김 전 총리는 정 전 대표를 앞에 두고 “지금은 자기 정치를 할 시간이 아니”라며 직격했고, 정 전 대표는 “한 번도 당을 떠난 적 없고, 헌신했다”며 김 전 총리가 과거 민주당을 탈당했던 전력을 부각했다.)

The two attended the third Supreme Committee meeting held at the Democratic Party's North Jeolla Provincial Party office in Jeonju that afternoon. They sat side by side after shaking hands, and Kim even patted Jeong on the back, but once the greetings began, they began throwing checks at each other. (두 사람은 이날 오후 전북 전주시 민주당 전북도당에서 열린 제3차 상무위원회에 나란히 참석했다. 두 사람은 악수를 한 뒤 나란히 앉았고 김 전 총리가 정 전 대표의 등을 쓰다듬기도 했지만 인사말이 시작되자 상대방을 향해 견제구를 던졌다.)

In his greetings, former Prime Minister Kim said, "Now is not the time for self-serving politics, nor is it the election season," adding, "Everyone must become pro-Lee (pro-Lee Jae-myung). If there is any deficiency in that, it will ultimately be the same as being anti-Lee." On the 6th, while declaring his candidacy for party leader, Kim had targeted Jeong, saying, "The harm of self-serving politics has thrown the party and its cooperation with the government into confusion." (김 전 총리는 인사말에서 “지금은 자기 정치를 할 시간도 아니고 또 대선의 시기가 아니다”라며 “모두가 친명(친이재명)이 되어야 한다. 만약에 그것에 부족함이 있다면 그것은 결과적으로는 반명이 되는 것이나 마찬가지일 것”이라고 했다. 김 전 총리는 지난 6일 당 대표 출마 선언을 하면서 ‘자기 정치의 폐해가 당과 당정 협력을 혼선에 빠트렸다’라고 정 전 대표를 겨냥한 바 있다.)

Furthermore, Kim stated, "To be honest, if things continue like this, it's true that I have concerns about whether we can stably win the next general election when it's held," and added, "I will become a party leader who firmly supports the president, wins the general election, and creates the future of North Jeolla Province." (아울러 김 전 총리는 “솔직히 얘기하면 지금 이대로 가면 내일모레 선거를 치르면 총선에서 우리가 안정적으로 승리할 수 있을까 하는 걱정이 있는 것도 사실”이라면서 “대통령을 확실하게 뒷받침하고 총선에 승리하고 전북의 미래를 만들 당 대표가 되겠다”라고 했다.)

Following that, former Representative Jeong, who gave his greetings, counterattacked, saying, "I fully agree with former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok's remarks and will add a few more words." He emphasized his background as a member of 'Nosamo' (an organization supporting the late President Roh Moo-hyun), saying, "When President Roh Moo-hyun was alive, there was all kinds of ridicule and criticism, but after his death, we came to understand Roh's values." He also added, "I have never left the party even once, and even when I faced an unfair cut-off, I dedicated myself to the party. I am the right person, having created a larger campaign speech team and toured the country." This is interpreted as an effort to highlight Kim's history of leaving the party (the candidate unification committee incident) during the 'Roh Moo-hyun-Chung Mong-joon unification' process ahead of the 2002 presidential election and to assert that he himself is continuing the legitimacy of the Democratic Party. (이어서 인사말을 한 정 전 대표는 “김민석 전 총리님 말씀에 100% 동의하고 플러스 몇 말씀 드리도록 하겠다”고 반격에 나섰다. 그는 “노무현 대통령이 살아계실 땐 온갖 조롱과 비판이 있었지만, 서거 이후 노무현의 가치를 알게 됐다”라며 자신이 ‘노사모’ 출신임을 재차 강조했다. 또 “한 번도 당을 떠난 적 없고, 억울한 컷오프를 했어도 당을 위해 헌신했고, 더 큰 유세단을 만들어 전국을 유세 다닌 제가 적임자”라고 했다. 2002년 대선을 앞두고 ‘노무현-정몽준 단일화’ 과정에서 탈당(후보단일화협의회 사태)한 바 있는 김 전 총리의 이력을 부각하고, 자신이 민주당의 정통성을 잇고 있다고 강조한 것으로 풀이된다.)

Former Representative Jeong emphasized his own clarity, saying, "The complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers—many people are skeptical. Who should become party leader to achieve that? It's not about words; you can tell from the arduous process of the past year," and added, "We must reform and reform again." (정 전 대표는 “보완수사권 전면 폐지, 많은 사람이 의심하고 있다. 누가 당 대표가 돼야 그걸 할 수 있는지, 그건 말이 아니라 지난 1년의 지난한 과정을 보면 알 수 있다”라며 “개혁하고 또 개혁해야 한다”고 자신의 선명성을 부각했다.)

After the event, Jeong told reporters regarding the controversial introduction of a preferential voting system for the national convention within the party: "It seems difficult to avoid controversy that (the preferential voting system) violates the party constitution and party rules," and added, "I have requested Acting Party Leader Han Byeong-do to resolve the controversy over violating the party constitution and party rules." (정 전 대표는 행사를 마치고 기자들에게 정 전 대표는 현재 당내에서 논란 중인 전당대회 선호투표제 도입에 대해선 “(선호투표제가) 당헌·당규 위반이라는 논란에서 비껴가기는 어려울 것 같다”라며 “당헌·당규 위반 논란을 해소해 달라 이렇게 한병도 당 대표 대행께 부탁드렸다”라고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, Rep. Song Young-gil, who has declared his candidacy for party leader, targeted the party sentiment in South Jeolla and Gwangju by holding a briefing at Samsung Electronics' Gwangju plant in the morning and hosting a town hall meeting with Gwangju party members at the Yeomju Gymnasium National Sports Center in the afternoon. In the town hall meeting, Rep. Song blamed former Representative Jeong for the defeat in key battlegrounds of the June 3 local elections, saying, "We lost in Seoul, almost won in Daegu but lost, and in Busan North Gap, if you had to nominate someone from the Blue House, you should have ensured they won, but you neglected it and let them lose; we also lost in Pyeongtaek. If someone who evaluates that the Democratic Party did well leads the party, can we win the general election?" (한편, 당대표 출마를 선언한 송영길 의원은 이날 오전 삼성전자 광주사업장에서 간담회를 열고, 오후 염주체육관 국민생활관에서 광주 당원 타운홀 미팅을 개최하는 등 전남광주 당심을 공략했다. 송 의원은 타운홀 미팅에서 “서울에서 지고, 대구에서 이길 뻔했는데 지고, 부산 북갑에 굳이 청와대 있는 사람 공천했으면 이기게 해야지 방치하다 져버리고, 평택도 졌다”며 “민주당이 잘 이겼다고 평가하는 사람이 민주당을 이끌고 가면 총선에서 이길 수 있겠나”고 6·3 지방선거 격전지 패배의 책임을 정 전 대표에게 돌렸다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Three Seoul City Election Commission members resign, citing "Central Election Commission undermined fairness and independence of election petitions" (서울시선관위원 3명 사임서 보니…“중앙선관위, 선거소청 공정성·독립성 침해”)
item.description:
It has been revealed that three members of the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission recently submitted their resignations, claiming in their resignation letters that they "received directives from the National Election Commission effectively instructing them to dismiss election petitions," arguing that this "violated the fairness and independence of the deliberation and decision-making process for election petitions." Previously, the National Election Commission stated that the directives they allegedly received were "reference materials among working-level staff" and that it does not interfere with the handling of election petitions by city and provincial election commissions. (서울시선거관리위원회 선관위원 3인이 최근 사임계를 내면서 사임서에 “중앙선거관리위원회로부터 사실상 선거소청을 기각하란 취지의 지침을 받았다”며 “선거소청에 대한 심리·의결의 공정성과 독립성을 침해한 것”이라고 주장한 것으로 파악됐다. 중앙선관위는 앞서 이들이 받았다는 지침이 “실무직원 간 참고자료”라며 시·도 선관위의 선거소청 심리 등에 관여하지 않는다고 밝힌 바 있다.)

According to the resignation letters of the three Seoul election commissioners obtained by *The Hankyoreh* on the 10th via Yoon Geon-young, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, they explained their reasons for resigning, stating: "At a time when the fairness and independence of the election petition process are demanded more than ever, continuing to participate in the petition process under circumstances where serious questions have been raised about these principles would only add an appearance of legitimacy to a compromised procedure, thereby undermining the procedural fairness that the public demands in the management of public elections." (한겨레가 10일 윤건영 더불어민주당 의원을 통해 확보한 서울시 선관위원 3인의 사임서를 보면, 이들은 “선거소청 절차의 공정성과 독립성이 그 어느 때보다 요구되는 지금, 이에 대한 중대한 의문이 제기된 상태에서 소청절차에 계속 참여하는 것은 훼손된 절차에 정당성의 외관만을 더하여 국민이 공직선거 관리에 요구하는 절차적 공정성을 도리어 해치는 결과가 될 수 있다고 판단했다”고 사임 이유를 밝혔다.)

An election petition is a procedure to challenge the validity of an election by contesting the illegality or impropriety of election results or the election process. Once a petition is filed, the election commission's petition review committee must render a decision within 60 days. (선거소청은 선거 결과나 선거 과정의 위법·부당함에 불복해 선거 효력에 이의를 제기하는 절차로, 소청이 접수되면 선관위 소청심사위에서 60일 내 소청에 대한 결정을 내려야 한다.)

Their reference to "a state where serious questions have been raised about the fairness and independence of the election petition process" stems from directives issued by the National Election Commission. In their resignation letters, the three Seoul election commissioners stated: "A staff member from the Guidance Division of the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission explained that these were 'handed down from the National Election Commission' and delivered three documents titled 'Reference Materials' to us via email. These documents contained content recommending 'dismissal' regarding key issues of the petitions, such as ballot shortages, and also included instructions for each city and provincial commission to draft decision statements accordingly." (이들이 ‘선거소청 절차의 공정성과 독립성에 중대한 의문이 제기된 상태’라고 한 것은 중앙선관위가 전달한 지침 때문이다. 서울시 선관위원 3인은 사임서에 “서울특별시 선거관리위원회 지도과 직원이 ‘중앙선거관리위원회로부터 하달받은 것’이라고 설명하며 ‘참고자료’라는 제목으로 3건의 문서를 저희 3인에게 이메일로 전달했다”며 “이 문서에는 투표용지 부족 등 소청의 주요 쟁점에 관하여 ‘기각’ 취지의 내용이 포함되어 있었고, 각 시·도위원회로 하여금 그에 맞추어 결정문의 내용을 작성하도록 하는 부분도 포함되어 있었다”고 밝혔다.)

They emphasized: "Under the Public Official Election Act, decisions on election petitions are quasi-judicial duties that the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission must deliberate and judge through meetings and resolutions in its capacity as an independent body. Nevertheless, it is difficult to avoid assessing that the National Election Commission, as a superior agency, predetermined the conclusions and key content of the decision statements and handed them down, which violates the fairness and independence of the deliberation and decision-making process for election petitions and is unlawful." (이들은 “공직선거법상 선거소청의 결정은 서울특별시선거관리위원회가 독립적 기관의 지위에서 회의와 의결로써 심리·판단하여야 하는 준사법적 직무”라며 “그럼에도 불구하고 상급기관인 중앙선거관리위원회가 소청의 결론과 결정문의 주요 내용을 미리 정하여 하달한 것인바, 이는 선거소청에 대한 심리·의결의 공정성과 독립성을 침해하는 것으로서 위법하다는 평가를 피하기 어렵다”고 강조했다.)

Previously, on the 9th, the National Election Commission issued an explanatory statement regarding the resignations of the three Seoul election commissioners, stating: "The National Election Commission does not interfere with the decisions of city and provincial election commissions on election petitions," and "the materials in question are reference materials among working-level staff of the election commission, not operational directives." It further explained that "these are merely internal reference materials shared via email among working-level staff of the election commission and were not written or distributed for the purpose of being delivered or utilized by election commissioners." (앞서 지난 9일 중앙선관위는 서울시 선관위원 3인의 사임에 대해 설명자료를 통해 “중앙선관위는 시·도선거관리위원회 선거소청 결정에 관여하지 않는다”며 “해당자료는 업무지침이 아닌 선거관리위원회 실무직원 간 참고자료”라고 설명한 바 있다. 그러면서 해당 지침에 대해 “선관위 실무직원 간 이메일을 통해 공유된 내부 참고자료일 뿐이며, 선관위원들에게 전달·활용될 목적으로 작성·배포된 것이 아니다”라고 해명했다.)

However, the three Seoul election commissioners claimed in their resignation letters that the materials were not only delivered to the commissioners but also included specific directives. Indeed, the documents contain reviews recommending dismissal for frequently cited petition reasons, such as "voter turnout exceeding 100%" and "differences between the number of ballots issued and the number of votes cast." (그러나 서울시선관위원 3인은 사임서에서 해당 자료가 선관위원들에게까지 전달됐을 뿐 아니라 구체적인 지침까지 포함됐다고 주장한 것이다. 실제로 해당 문서를 보면, ‘투표율 100% 초과’, ‘투표용지 교부수와 투표수의 차이’ 등 자주 언급된 소청 사유들에 대한 기각 취지의 검토내용이 담겨있다.)

item.title: North Korea Expands ‘Reconnaissance General Bureau’ for Operations Against South… Likely to Strengthen Intelligence Collection on Neighboring Countries (북한, 대남 공작 ‘정찰정보총국’ 확대…주변국 정보 수집 기능 강화하나)
item.description:
North Korea is seeking ways to dramatically enhance its military reconnaissance and intelligence capabilities by expanding the missions of the Reconnaissance General Bureau during a military meeting. <<> The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 10th that Chairman Kim Jong-un said at the 1st Enlarged Meeting of the 9th Central Military Commission of the Workers’ Party of Korea the previous day (the 9th) that “only by building a strong military can we control everything and suppress threats, thereby achieving true peace.” <<> This enlarged meeting of the Central Military Commission follows the 9th Party Congress and 1st Plenary Meeting in February and the 2nd Plenary Enlarged Meeting (in June) of the 9th term, focusing on carrying out the military tasks presented at the previous meetings. The KCNA reported that Chairman Kim declared key tasks for the entire military, stating, “The People’s Army must be thoroughly field-oriented and modernized, and its combat capabilities enhanced.” <<> In particular, the KCNA reported that at this enlarged meeting, “tasks and measures were raised to expand the functions and missions of the Reconnaissance General Bureau in various ways and to enhance the bureau’s military reconnaissance and intelligence capabilities.” The Ministry of Unification views the Reconnaissance General Bureau as an organization expanded and reorganized from the existing Reconnaissance General Bureau under the General Staff Department of the People’s Army. The existence of the Reconnaissance General Bureau was first confirmed in remarks by Vice Chairman of the Party’s Central Military Commission, Park Jong-chon, in September last year. The Reconnaissance General Bureau is North Korea’s agency for intelligence collection and operations against South Korea and overseas; the addition of “Information” (or Intelligence) is seen as a move to strengthen its capabilities for acquiring and analyzing foreign intelligence. <<> The KCNA reported that the Reconnaissance General Bureau “plays a key role in managing threats from potential adversaries and collecting critical intelligence.” The use of the phrase “potential adversaries” is interpreted to mean that not only South Korea but also entities that could become future enemies are subjects of intelligence collection and surveillance. <<> However, the KCNA did not report on how the Reconnaissance General Bureau’s missions would be specifically expanded. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, believes its functions could expand in the areas of military reconnaissance, overseas human intelligence, and cyber operations. Senior Researcher Hong stated, “According to the two-state theory, it is transitioning from an anti-South intelligence agency to a (expanded) foreign intelligence agency, adapting to the era of technical intelligence like satellites and cyber, and the result of changes from division of labor with the existing State Security Department and a broadened perspective due to participation in the Ukraine war.” <<> At a regular briefing on the same day, the Ministry of Unification stated, “We will closely monitor trends related to the expansion of the functions and missions of the Reconnaissance General Bureau in coordination with relevant agencies.” There are also predictions that the expanded role of this agency will lead to increased espionage activities against Japan, the United States, and others, in addition to operations against South Korea. <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (북한이 군사 회의에서 정찰정보총국 임무를 확대해 군사정찰 및 정보첩보능력을 획기적으로 끌어올리기 위한 방안을 모색하고 있다.)

item.title: Giving performance bonuses in local currency?... Lawmaker Park Min-kyu withdraws bill amid growing controversy (성과급을 지역화폐로 준다고?…박민규 의원, 법안 논란 커지자 철회)
item.description:
Park Min-kyu, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, withdrew his sponsorship of a bill to amend the Labor Standards Act on the 10th after it sparked controversy. The bill would have allowed companies to pay a portion of workers' wages (such as performance bonuses) in local currency. The withdrawal followed criticism that the bill undermines the principle of paying wages in currency and could lead to a reduction in workers' real wages, prompting calls for its retraction. (박민규 더불어민주당 의원이 기업이 노동자 임금 일부(성과급 등)를 지역화폐로 지급할 수 있게 하는 근로기준법 개정안을 발의했다가 논란이 되자 10일 법안 발의를 철회했다. 해당 법안 발의 뒤 임금의 통화 지급 원칙을 훼손하고, 노동자의 실질임금 삭감을 가져올 수 있다는 등의 비판이 제기되며 철회 요구가 터져나왔기 때문이다.)

In a Facebook post on the same day, Lawmaker Park stated, "I humbly accept public opinion and have withdrawn the amendment to the Labor Standards Act that I sponsored," adding, "I will prepare more carefully for ways our companies can grow together with local communities." (박민규 의원은 이날 페이스북에 “여론을 겸허히 받아들여 제가 대표 발의한 근로기준법 개정안은 철회했다”며 “우리 기업들이 지역사회와 더불어 성장할 방법을 더 세심히 준비하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

On the 8th, Park sponsored the amendment that, with a collective agreement or explicit consent from workers, would have allowed part of wages, including performance bonuses, to be paid in local love gift certificates. Park explained the proposal's rationale, saying, "It could contribute to regional balanced development through revitalizing local economies." (박 의원은 지난 8일 단체협약이나 근로자의 명시적 동의가 있는 경우, 성과급 등 임금 일부를 지역사랑 상품권으로 지급할 수 있게 하는 근로기준법 개정안을 대표 발의했다. 박 의원은 “지역경제 활성화로 인한 지역균형 발전에 기여할 수 있을 것”이라고 제안 이유를 설명했다.)

When news of Park's bill was reported, the opposition party criticized it, stating, "How to spend performance bonuses is the individual freedom of workers." At a morning party leadership meeting, Jeong Jeom-sik, floor leader of the People Power Party, pointed out, "Paying bonuses in gift certificates infringes on the freedom of choice that workers should naturally enjoy," and added, "As a responsible ruling party, even when sponsoring a bill, it should be carefully reviewed and studied before being presented." (앞서 박 의원의 법안 발의 소식이 알려지자 야당은 “성과급을 어떻게 소비할지는 근로자 개인의 자유”라고 비판했다. 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 오전 원내대책회의에서 “성과급을 상품권으로 지급한다면, 이는 근로자가 당연히 누려야 할 선택의 자유를 침해하는 것”이라며 “‘책임 있는 집권여당’답게 법안 하나를 발의하더라도 신중하게 따져보고 검토해서 내야 한다”고 지적했다.)

Both major labor union federations also opposed the bill the previous day, demanding its immediate withdrawal. The Korean Confederation of Trade Unions (KCTU) criticized, "Under the imbalance of power in employment relationships, 'consent' makes it difficult to ensure genuine free will," and noted, "Local love gift certificates have limited places and regions of use and expiry dates, which could effectively lead to a reduction in real wages." The Federation of Korean Trade Unions (FKTU) also pointed out, "Workers' wages are not a means for policy purposes but a right that must be fully guaranteed as compensation for labor," and added, "Although the bill presupposes 'explicit consent from workers,' in practice, coercion of consent may arise due to recruitment processes, performance evaluations, or organizational culture." (양대노총도 전날 법안에 반대 입장을 밝히며 즉각 철회를 요구했다. 전국민주노동조합총연맹(민주노총)은 “‘동의’는 고용관계 힘의 불균형 속에서 실질적 자유의사기 어렵다”며 “지역사랑 상품권은 사용처와 지역이 제한되고 유효기한이 있어 사실상 실질임금 삭감 효과를 낳을 수 있다”고 비판했다. 한국노동조합총연맹(한국노총)도 “노동자의 임금은 정책 목적을 위한 수단이 아니라, 노동의 대가로 온전히 보장돼야 할 권리”라며 “법안은 ‘근로자의 명시적 동의’를 전제로 하고 있지만, 노동 현장에서는 채용 과정이나 인사평가, 조직문화 등을 이유로 사실상 ‘동의 강요’가 발생할 수 있다”고 지적했다.)

Regarding the bill sponsored by Park, criticism poured in on social media and online communities, with some saying, "Members of the National Assembly should receive their salaries in local love gift certificates first." (박 의원이 발의한 법안을 두고 사회관계망서비스(SNS)나 온라인 커뮤니티에선 “국회의원 세비부터 지역사랑상품권으로 받아야 한다”는 등의 비판이 쏟아지기도 했다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President presents traditional Korean bow set and smartwatch to Mongolian President (이 대통령, 몽골 대통령에게 국궁 세트·스마트워치 선물)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, who is on a state visit to Mongolia, presented President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh with a traditional Korean bow set and a smartwatch on the 10th (local time). (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 10일(현지시각) 오흐나 후렐수흐 대통령에게 국궁 세트, 스마트워치 등을 선물했다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung announced that President Khürelsükh was gifted a traditional Korean bow set, made using traditional techniques by combining materials such as buffalo horn and bamboo. Archery is a shared traditional culture between the two countries and is one of the three main events of the Naadam Festival. Additionally, President Khürelsükh, who enjoys exercise, was also given a smartwatch equipped with the latest features. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 후렐수흐 대통령에게 물소뿔과 대나무 등을 복합적으로 접합해 전통 기법으로 제작한 국궁 세트를 선물했다고 밝혔다. 활쏘기는 양국이 공유하는 전통문화이자, 나담축제의 3대 종목 중 하나이기도 했다. 또 운동을 즐기는 후렐수흐 대통령에게는 최신 기능이 탑재된 스마트워치도 선물했다.)

First Lady Luvsandorj Bolortsetseg received a lacquered box adorned with butterfly and vine patterns. The box, decorated on the front with patterns of butterflies and 'dangcho' (a vine plant), symbolizes happiness and prosperity through the butterflies, while the vine, with its endlessly spreading nature, signifies prosperity and longevity. A jade color reminiscent of Mongolia's vast grasslands and abundant nature was also used. (롭상도르지 벌러르체첵 여사에게는 나비당초 높은 함을 선물했다. 나비와 덩굴식물인 ‘당초’ 문양으로 전면을 장식한 나전 함으로, 나비는 행복과 번영을 상징하고 덩굴은 끝없이 뻗어 나가는 특성 때문에 번영과 장수를 의미한다. 또 몽골의 광활한 초원과 풍요로운 자연이 연상되는 비취색도 사용했다.)

item.title: President Lee receives 'pistol and bullets' as gift from Turkish President (이 대통령, 튀르키예 대통령에게 ‘권총과 실탄’ 선물 받았다)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Mongolia, received a pistol engraved with his name and six bullets as a gift from Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan upon departing after the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit. (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의를 마친 뒤 출국 당시 레제프 타이이프 에르도안 튀르키예 대통령으로부터 이 대통령의 이름이 새겨진 권총과 실탄 6발을 선물받았다.)

The presidential office stated on the 11th (local time), "The firearm gift was approved for import after consultations between the presidential office, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the National Police Agency," adding, "The presidential office will securely transfer the firearm to the Presidential Archives under the management of the Presidential Security Service." Earlier, President Erdogan gifted pistols to various national leaders returning home after the NATO summit on the 7th and 8th. ( 청와대는 11일(현지시각) “해당 총기 선물은 청와대와 외교부가 경찰청과 협의하여 반입 승인을 받았다”며 “청와대는 해당 총기를 경호처의 관리 하에 대통령기록관으로 안전하게 이관할 것”이라고 말했다. 앞서 에르도안 대통령은 지난 7~8일 나토 정상회의를 마치고 귀국하는 각국 정상들에게 권총을 선물했다. )

The pistol was contained in a box engraved with the Turkish flag and NATO logo, along with the inscription, "The first revolver-type pistol produced in Turkey." President Erdogan’s choice of such an unconventional gift appears to aim at promoting Turkey's defense industry. ( 권총은 튀르키예 국기와 나토 로고가 새겨진 상자에 들어 있었고, ‘튀르키예에서 처음 생산된 리볼버형 권총’이라는 문구가 새겨져 있었다. 에르도안 대통령이 파격적인 선물을 택한 것은 튀르키예 방산을 홍보하려는 것으로 보인다.)

The pistol gift became known after UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer first mentioned it aboard the plane returning from Ankara. As it sparked interest, various national leaders disclosed the fact of receiving the pistol and explained the situation. Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever reported that upon returning home, he found the pistol in his luggage, handed it over to Brussels airport police, and it is now stored in a safe. Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar shared a photo of the pistol on social media, and Lithuanian President Gitanas Nausėda even posted an "unboxing" video. ( 권총 선물은 키어 스타머 영국 총리가 앙카라에서 돌아오는 비행기 안에서 처음 언급하면서 알려졌다. 그 뒤 화제가 되자 각국 정상은 권총 선물 사실을 공개하며 상황을 설명했다. 바르트 더 베베르 벨기에 총리는 귀국한 뒤 수하물에서 권총을 발견해 브뤼셀 공항 경찰에 인계하고 금고에 보관 중이라고 전했다. 페테르 마자르 헝가리 총리는 소셜미디어에 권총 사진을 공개했고, 기나타스 나우세다 리투아니아 대통령은 ‘언박싱’ 영상을 촬영해 올리기도 했다.)

The gifts received by Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten and Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson were left at their respective embassies in Ankara due to complex customs and transfer procedures. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney reportedly took the pistol but left the bullets in Turkey. ( 롭 예텐 네덜란드 총리, 울프 크리스테르손 스웨덴 총리가 받은 선물은 복잡한 통관·이송 절차에 일단 앙카라 자국 대사관에 두고 갔다. 마크 카니 캐나다 총리는 권총만 가져가고 실탄은 튀르키예에 남겨둔 것으로 전해졌다.)

Polish President Karol Nawrocki also stated that the pistol was transported safely, adding, "I don't think anyone will fire it, of course." Earlier, in late 2022, the Polish police chief brought an anti-tank grenade launcher received as a gift from Ukraine into his office, causing damage to the police headquarters' ceiling after an accidental discharge. ( 카롤 나브로츠키 폴란드 대통령도 권총이 안전하게 운송됐다며 “설마 아무도 쏘지 않을 것이라고 생각한다”고 말했다. 앞서 2022년 말 폴란드 경찰청장은 우크라이나에서 선물받은 대전차 유탄발사기를 집무실로 가져왔다가 오발 사고로 경찰청 천장이 파손되기도 했다.)

♣Ulaanbaatar/H6s by Seo Young-ji, reporter yj@hani.co.kr ( ♣울란바타르/H6s서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: The Integration of Service Academies Was Also Considered by the Chun Doo-hwan, Roh Tae-woo, and Lee Myung-bak Governments (사관학교 통합은 전두환·노태우·이명박 정부도 검토했다)
item.description:
The establishment of a unified National Armed Forces Academy, combining the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, has sparked strong opposition from retired military officers who are graduates of the Korea Military Academy (KMA). Those opposing the integration argue that the Lee Jae-myung administration is targeting current and retired generals from the KMA who led the December 3 insurrection, labeling the KMA as a "hotbed of coups," and that it is a political crackdown aimed at abolishing the KMA altogether. This perception underlies their view of the academy integration as a "closure of the KMA." (육·해·공군 사관학교를 통합한 국군사관학교 창설을 두고 육군사관학교(육사) 출신 예비역들의 반발이 거세다. 통합에 반대하는 쪽은 이재명 정부가 12·3 내란 사태에 앞장선 육사 출신 현역·예비역 장군들을 문제삼아 ‘육사=쿠데타의 온상’으로 지목해, 이참에 육사를 없애려는 정치적 탄압이라고 반발한다. 이들이 사관학교 통합을 ‘육사 폐교’라고 받아들이는 배경에는 이런 인식이 깔려 있다.)

Initially, those who proposed reform of the military academy education had concerns including: △ responding to the era of artificial intelligence (AI), robotics, and drones; △ fostering high expertise and adaptability in officers responsible for future national defense; △ ensuring rapid response and joint operations capability; and △ internalizing constitutional and democratic values. However, the debate has been engulfed in the controversy over the closure of the KMA, and no substantive discussion on educational reform has taken place. ( 애초 사관학교 교육 개혁을 제기한 쪽의 문제의식은 △인공지능(AI)·로봇·드론 시대 대응 △미래 국방을 책임질 장교로서 고도의 전문성과 적응력 △신속한 대응력과 합동성 △헌법과 민주주의 가치 내면화 등이었다. 하지만 육사 폐교 논란에 휩싸여 사관학교 교육 개혁 논의는 전혀 이뤄지지 않고 있다.)

Although the integration of service academies was a campaign promise of President Lee Jae-myung, it was not first proposed by his administration. The integration was also promoted or reviewed by the governments of Syngman Rhee, Chun Doo-hwan, Roh Tae-woo, and Lee Myung-bak. ( 사관학교 통합은 이재명 대통령의 대선 공약이지만, 이재명 정부가 처음 꺼낸 게 아니다. 사관학교 통합은 이승만·전두환·노태우·이명박 정부도 추진·검토했다.)

In the fall of 1953, U.S. Eighth Army Commander General Mark Clark argued for the integration of the service academies, citing that it would: facilitate joint operations by fostering a sense of unity among the Army, Navy, and Air Force; prevent waste of school facilities; and make it easier to secure excellent faculty. The plan proposed that first- and second-year cadets train and study together, while from the third year onward, they would specialize in their respective service branches based on individual preference and aptitude. At the time, Army Chief of Staff Paik Sun-yup supported the integration, but the Navy and Air Force opposed it, fearing they would be "absorbed into the KMA." ( 1953년 가을 마크 클라크 미 8군사령관은 △육·해·공군 간 일체감 조성으로 합동작전이 쉬워지고 △학교시설 낭비를 방지하고 우수 교수진 확보가 용이하다는 점을 들어 사관학교 통합을 주장했다. 1·2학년은 함께 훈련·교육하고 3학년부터 본인의 희망과 적성에 따라 각 군으로 나눠 전문교육을 실시하자는 방안이었다. 당시 백선엽 육군참모총장은 통합에 찬성했으나 해·공군은 ‘육사에 흡수된다’고 반대했다. )

After the April 19 Revolution in 1961, the then-Democratic Party government sought to integrate the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies into a National Defense Academy and even allocated a budget for it, but the plan fell through due to the May 16 coup. The rationale for integration at that time included: △ 70-75% of the curriculum across all service academies, primarily in liberal arts courses, was common; and △ modern warfare cannot be conducted by a single service branch alone, requiring close joint operations among the Army, Navy, Air Force, and Marine Corps. The Army and Air Force were in favor, but the Navy opposed it. ( 4·19 혁명 뒤인 1961년 당시 민주당 정부는 육·해·공군 사관학교를 국방사관학교로 통합하려고 예산에도 반영했으나 5·16 쿠데타로 무산됐다. 당시 사관학교 통합의 필요성으로 △사관학교 전 교과과정에서 교양과목을 중심으로 70~75% 교과내용이 공통이고 △현대전을 어느 특정 군만으로 수행할 수 없고 육·해·공군, 해병대가 긴밀한 합동작전을 펴야 한다 등이 제기됐다. 당시 육군과 공군은 찬성했으나 해군이 반대했다.)

During the 1980s, the Chun Doo-hwan and Roh Tae-woo governments also reviewed the integration of service academies. The Lee Myung-bak administration pursued integration as part of defense reforms following the Cheonan sinking and the Yeonpyeong Island shelling. At that time, the Army supported it, but graduates of the Naval and Air Force academies, fearing "absorption," opposed it, leading to the plan's failure. (1980년대 전두환·노태우 정부 때도 사관학교 통합이 검토됐다. 이명박 정부는 천안함 사건과 연평도 포격전 이후 국방개혁 차원에서 사관학교 통합을 추진했다. 당시 육군은 찬성했지만 ‘흡수 통합’을 우려한 해사와 공사 출신들이 반대해 무산됐다.)

The controversies surrounding military academy education stem from its dual purpose. Service academies are special-purpose universities whose primary mission is to train officers. There is a fundamental divide between viewing the academies as "universities" versus as "military units." Those who see them as units emphasize the cultivation of officer qualities, focusing on military training and discipline, and believe that academic majors need only provide basic skills for performing officer duties. The current opponents of academy integration tend to view service academies as units. ( 사관학교 교육을 둘러싼 논란은 사관학교 교육의 이중 목적성에서 시작한다. 사관학교는 장교 양성을 기본 임무로 하는 특수목적 대학이다. 사관학교를 두고 ‘대학’이란 입장과 ‘군 부대’란 입장이 근본적으로 갈라진다. 사관학교를 부대로 보는 이들은 장교로서의 자질 함양을 강조하면서 군사훈련과 훈육에 초점을 두어야 하며 학문분야 전공은 장교로서의 직무 수행을 위한 기초능력을 키우는 정도면 된다고 본다. 요즘 사관학교 통합을 반대하는 쪽은 사관학교를 부대라고 본다.)

Within the military, service academies are regarded as units commanded by three-star generals. The academy superintendent operates the academy from a unit command perspective and has been criticized for frequently changing the educational content based on command policies stemming from personal experience. In the past five years, superintendents have been replaced so often that their average tenure has been less than a year. ( 군 내부에선 사관학교를 3성 장군이 지휘하는 부대로 여긴다. 사관학교 교장은 부대지휘 차원에서 사관학교 운영을 하고 개인적 경험에 기초한 지휘방침에 따라 교육 내용을 수시로 변경해왔다는 지적을 받는다. 최근 5년간 사관학교 교장들의 평균 임기가 1년 미만일 정도로 교체가 잦았다.)

According to a survey conducted by the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses in September 2024 involving 794 junior and senior cadets (316 from the KMA, 137 from the Naval Academy, and 341 from the Air Force Academy) and 950 active-duty officers (302 from service academies), a majority opinion was that the focus of service academy education needs to shift from training junior officers to cultivating leaders who will guide the future military. It was suggested that practical competencies should be handled by continuing education, while service academy education should focus on building foundational skills and values. ( 2024년 9월 한국국방연구원이 사관생도 3~4학년 794명(육사 316명, 해사 137명, 공사 341명) 및 현역장교 950명(사관학교 출신 302명)을 대상으로 벌인 설문조사 결과를 보면 사관학교 교육의 초점이 초급장교 양성에서 벗어나 미래 군을 이끌어갈 리더 양성 교육으로의 전환이 필요하며, 실무역량은 보수 교육에서 담당하고 사관학교 교육은 기초역량 및 가치관 함양에 초점을 둬야 한다는 의견이 다수였다. )

Respondents cited the reasons for the perceived decline in the status of service academies compared to the past as a decrease in preference for the officer profession, low autonomy in cadet life, and lower educational quality compared to civilian universities, making it difficult to attract excellent cadets and thus gradually lowering the quality of cadets. Therefore, they pointed to the need to expand educational autonomy and openness, flexibly improve the curriculum, and implement higher-level integrated management of service academies. (응답자들은 과거보다 사관학교 위상이 낮아진 이유로 장교 직업 선호도 하락과 생도 생활의 낮은 자율성, 민간 대학보다 낮은 교육의 질 등으로 인해 우수한 사관생도의 유입이 어렵고 이로 인해 생도 자질이 점차 낮아진다고 밝혔다. 따라서 교육의 자율성·개방성 확대 및 교육과정의 유연한 개선이 필요하며, 사관학교에 대한 상위 수준의 통합 관리가 필요하다고 지적했다.)

In January, the service academy reform subcommittee under the "Civil-Military-Government Joint Special Advisory Committee for Overcoming the Insurrection and Designing Future National Defense" presented a recommendation for a "2+2 network-type integration." Under this plan, first- and second-year cadets from the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies would receive foundational academic and basic military training together, while in their third and fourth years, they would undergo specialized education and military training at their respective service academies. ( 지난 1월 ‘내란극복·미래국방 설계를 위한 민관군 합동 특별자문위원회’ 산하 사관학교 개혁분과가 내놓은 권고안은 ‘2+2 네트워크형 통합’이었다. 육·해·공사 생도들이 1·2학년 때 함께 기초학문과 군사기초교육을 받고, 3·4학년에는 각 군 사관학교에서 전문교육과 군사훈련을 받는 방식이다. )

The recommendation included a plan to establish a "National Armed Forces University" that would encompass not only the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies but also the Defense Advanced Science and Technology Academy, the Defense Medical Academy, the ROTC and OCS training units, and the Korea National Defense University Graduate School. The long-term aim was to create a comprehensive university that incorporates all eight officer training institutions as individual colleges. ( ‘권고안에는 육·해·공사뿐 아니라 국방첨단과학기술사관학교, 국방의무사관학교, 학군·학사장교 교육단, 국방과학기술대학원까지 포괄하는 ‘국군사관대학교’ 설립 방안이 담겼다. 장기적으로 8개 장교 양성기관을 단과 대학 개념으로 포괄하는 종합대학교를 만들자는 취지였다.)

The English name of the Korea Military Academy is "KOREA MILITARY ACADEMY." The background behind naming the officer-training academy an "academy" is rooted in Plato's ideal of the "philosopher-king," where capable elites who can distinguish truth from illusion lead the public toward goodness and beauty. The discussion on service academy integration should begin with whether the current academies live up to the name "academy." ( 육군사관학교의 영문 표기는 ‘KOREA MILITARY ACADEMY’(코리아 밀리터리 아카데미)다. 장교를 키우는 사관학교를 아카데미로 명명한 배경에는 진리와 허상을 구별하는 능력 있는 엘리트가 대중을 선과 아름다움으로 향하도록 이끈다는 플라톤의 ‘철인’ 이상이 자리 잡고 있다. 사관학교 통합 논의가 지금 사관학교가 ‘아카데미’란 이름값을 하고 있는지에서 출발할 필요가 있다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr ( 권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: North Korea and China Exchange Messages on 65th Anniversary of Friendship Treaty, Voicing "Strategic Cooperation" in Unison (북-중, 우호조약 65주년 맞축전…“전략적 협력” 한목소리)
item.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping and North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un exchanged congratulatory messages on the 11th, the 65th anniversary of the signing of the "North Korea-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance," reaffirming their commitment to strengthening strategic cooperative ties. <<> According to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA), Chairman Kim stated in his message to President Xi, "The DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relations are today being elevated and developed to a new strategic height, making a great contribution to firmly defending the sovereignty, security, and development interests of both countries and safeguarding peace and stability in the region and the world amid the complex and multifaceted international situation." He added, "I am ready to guide the DPRK-China friendship, rooted in its excellent history and tradition, to a new height and develop it into the most robust and strategic model of relations between socialist countries." Regarding Chairman Xi's state visit to Pyongyang last month, Kim noted that "through the historic meeting in Pyongyang, I and General Secretary Xi Jinping once again confirmed our will to jointly build a beautiful future for the peoples of both countries on the path of struggle for the victorious advance of the socialist cause." <<> Chinese President Xi Jinping, in his message to Chairman Kim, stated, "This June, I successfully conducted a state visit to the DPRK, reaching important common understandings with General Secretary Comrade Kim Jong Un on inheriting and consolidating the traditional China-DPRK friendship and endowing it with new contemporary significance, thereby establishing the strategic direction and new blueprint for the development of China-DPRK relations in the new era." He further expressed, "I am ready to further strengthen strategic communication, firmly grasp the direction of developing bilateral relations, guide the friendly cooperation between both sides to bring greater well-being to the peoples of the two countries, and actively contribute to promoting peace and development in the region." <<> KCNA reported on the same day that North Korean delegation leader and Cabinet Premier Pak Thae Song, who visited China the previous day, met with President Xi at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. While Xinhua News Agency's report on their meeting included Premier Pak's remarks, such as "firmly supporting the defense of China's core interests, including the Taiwan issue," and that "bilateral relations should be developed in line with the changing times, consolidating each side's socialist cause and promoting national modernization," these statements were not featured in North Korean media. <<> Rodong Sinmun, in an editorial, emphasized bilateral relations, stating that North Korea "adheres to the DPRK-China friendship as the most important and foremost strategic undertaking." <<> Reporter Im In-taek imit@hani.co.kr, Yonhap News Agency (중국 시진핑 주석과 북한 김정은 국무위원장이 ‘북중 우호협력 및 상호원조조약 체결 65주년’ 기념일인 11일 축전을 교환해 전략적 협력 관계 강화 의지를 거듭 표명했다.)

item.title: President Lee Draws a Bowstring at Mongolia's Biggest Festival, Naadam (이 대통령, 몽골 최대 명절 ‘나담축제’서 활시위 당겼다)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung attended the opening ceremony of Mongolia's biggest festival, Naadam, as guests of honor on the last day of their state visit to Mongolia on the 11th (local time). <<> During his opening speech at the Naadam Festival held at the National Sports Stadium in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh mentioned President Lee, saying, "Thank you for attending on behalf of the Republic of Korea." President Lee and First Lady Kim responded with applause. The Naadam Festival is a national event celebrating Mongolia's freedom and independence, and this marks the first time a South Korean head of state has been invited as a guest of honor. <<> During the Naadam Festival, two riders on horseback carried the South Korean flag and the Mongolian flag, respectively, and rode a large lap around the stadium. After attending the two-hour opening ceremony, President Lee left the venue with President Khürelsükh and his wife. <<> Later, President Lee visited the archery field, one of the three main events of the Naadam Festival, along with President Khürelsükh, and experienced archery. President Lee pulled the bowstring forcefully toward the sky. Afterwards, President Lee carefully watched First Lady Kim as she adjusted her bow for archery. First Lady Kim walked to the front of the field and shot an arrow into the air, receiving applause from the attendees. <<> President Lee concluded his three-day state visit to Mongolia with a farewell luncheon hosted by President Khürelsükh and then departed for home. <<> Ulaanbaatar/Reported by Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령과 김혜경 여사가 몽골 국빈 방문 마지막 날인 11일(현지시각) 몽골 최대 명절인 ‘나담축제’ 개막식에 주빈으로 참석했다.)

item.title: Trump warns Iran of "total annihilation" if assassination attempt on him occurs (트럼프, 이란에 “나를 향한 암살 시도 땐 완전 궤멸” 경고)
item.description:
U.S. President Donald Trump has warned that if Iran attempts to assassinate him, he will completely devastate the entire country of Iran. (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 이란이 자신에게 암살을 시도할 경우 이란 전역을 초토화하겠다고 경고했다.)

In a post on his social media platform Truth Social late on the 10th (local time), Trump stated, "If the Iranian government, as they have publicly declared around the world, assassinates or attempts to assassinate the current U.S. president, namely me, 1,000 missiles are already loaded and aimed at Iran, and thousands more will be launched immediately." He added, "The orders have already been given, and the U.S. military is prepared, willing, and capable to completely decimate and destroy all of Iran for a year, with the possibility of extension if necessary." (트럼프 대통령은 10일 밤(현지 시간) 소셜미디어 트루스소셜에 글을 올려 “이란 정부가 전세계 곳곳에서 공언한 대로 현직 미국 대통령, 즉 나를 암살하거나 암살을 시도할 경우, 1천기의 미사일이 이미 이란을 겨냥해 장전 완료되어 있고, 즉시 수천발의 미사일이 추가 발사될 것”이라고 밝혔다. 트럼프는 이어 “명령은 이미 하달되었으며, 미군은 1년 동안, 필요하면 연장도 가능한 상태로, 이란 전역을 완전히 초토화시키고 파괴할 준비와 의지, 능력을 갖추고 있다”고 말했다.)

This comes in response to public calls for Trump's assassination during the large-scale funeral last week for Iran's former Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, which was held over six days. Trump had previously stated on the 8th, "I am Iran's number one assassination target." Upon returning from the NATO summit held in Turkey on the 7th and 8th, he reportedly switched to a different plane, seemingly as a precaution against assassination threats. (이는 지난주 6일장으로 진행된 이란 전 최고지도자 아야톨라 알리 하메네이의 대규모 장례 동안 트럼프를 암살해야 한다는 목소리가 공개적으로 나온 데 따른 대응이다. 트럼프 대통령은 앞선 8일 “나는 이란의 암살 대상 1순위”라고 말한 바 있다. 지난 7~8일 튀르키예에서 열린 북대서양조약기구(NATO, 나토) 정상회의 뒤 귀국 과정에선 암살 위협에 대비하는 듯 전용기를 갈아타기도 했다.)

Trump concluded his post with the phrase, "PRAISE BE TO ALLAH!" He has occasionally used this expression, such as during last year's Easter message, but it has drawn criticism. As a customary Islamic phrase used in prayers and daily life to express praise and gratitude to the one God, it is interpreted as the U.S. president's contempt and mockery of Islam. Trump remains unbothered. Earlier that day, he officially declared the end of the ceasefire with Iran. (트럼프는 한편 이번 게시글을 “알라에게 찬양을(PRAISE BE TO ALLAH!)”이라는 문구로 마무리했다. 지난해 부활절 메시지를 띄울 때 등 때때로 사용했으나 비판이 뒤따랐다. 유일신에 대한 찬양과 감사 표현으로 기도나 일상생활 때 쓰는 이슬람의 관용 어구로, 미국 대통령의 이슬람에 대한 경멸과 조롱으로 해석되기 때문이다. 트럼프는 개의치 않고 있다. 그는 이날 앞서 이란과의 휴전 종료를 공식 선언했다.)

Reporter Im In-taek imit@hani.co.kr (임인택 기자 imit@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee receives pony gift at traditional ger luncheon on final day of Mongolia visit (이 대통령, 몽골 방문 마지막 날 게르 오찬…조랑말 선물 받아)
item.description:
On the final day of his state visit to Mongolia, President Lee Jae-myung shared a farewell luncheon with President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh at a banquet hall styled after a traditional ger (yurt) on the 11th (local time), enjoying a final moment of camaraderie. <<> Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jung stated that President Khürelsükh invited President Lee and his wife to the ger-style banquet hall built on the grassland, considering that they had not fully explored Mongolia's vast natural landscapes during their state visit. <<> Upon President Lee's arrival, the Mongolian side showcased a traditional method of milking a mare alongside a pony, while sheep could be seen grazing on a green hill in the distance. Behind the ger, they presented the traditional anklebone shooting game and herding dogs. They also demonstrated the traditional cooking method of heating stones inside sheepskin to cook meat. <<> President Lee and his wife then entered the ger with President Khürelsükh and his wife for the luncheon. After the meal, as they exited the ger, a scaled-down version of the Naadam festival, called 'Mini Naadam Show,' was prepared. Wrestlers competed, and the winner performed a traditional dance imitating an eagle, then handed a handful of traditional snacks to President Lee and his wife. Following this, acrobat 'Erdeneochir,' who gained fame through the popular Korean survival show 'Physical Asia,' delivered an acrobatic performance. <<> President Khürelsükh also presented two ponies as gifts to President Lee and his wife. On the spot, President Lee and his wife named the mare 'Rainbow' and the stallion 'Gold.' Senior Press Secretary Kang explained, "These names symbolize the opening of a golden era in Korea-Mongolia relations through the meeting of the two leaders and the state visit, inspired by Mongolia being called the 'Land of the Blue Sky' and Korea the 'Land of the Rainbow.'" However, the two ponies are scheduled to be raised in Mongolia. <<> Ulaanbaatar / Correspondent Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 몽골 국빈 방문 마지막 날인 11일(현지시각) 전통 게르 양식의 영빈관에서 오흐나 후렐수흐 대통령과 오찬을 하며 마지막 친교 시간을 가졌다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk's Resignation: The Only Way to Save Conservatism (장동혁 사퇴, 보수 살리는 유일한 길)
item.description:
Politics is a competition of who does better. If you are even slightly better than your opponent, you win the election. Conversely, it's also a competition of who is less incompetent. Even if you are not good, if your opponent is worse than you, you win the election. (정치는 누가 누가 잘하나 경쟁입니다. 경쟁 상대보다 내가 조금이라도 더 잘하면 선거에서 이깁니다. 반대로 누가 누가 덜 못 하나 경쟁이기도 합니다. 내가 못해도 경쟁 상대가 나보다 더 못하면 선거에서 이깁니다.)

President Lee Jae-myung seems to understand this nature of politics. In May 2025, amid the turmoil over the People Power Party's presidential candidate change, he introduced a remark by former President Kim Young-sam: "In politics, it's not about us doing well. If we just stay still, the other side will fall flat on their face. Then we win." (정치의 이런 속성을 이재명 대통령도 아는 것 같습니다. 2025년 5월 국민의힘 대선 후보 교체 파동을 보고 “정치는 우리가 잘한다고 되는 게 아니라, 가만히 있으면 상대방이 자빠진다. 그러면 우리가 이기는 것이다”라는 김영삼 전 대통령의 말을 소개한 일이 있습니다.)

President Lee Jae-myung's recent job performance ratings are not bad. In a regular Gallup Korea poll released on July 10th, positive approval of the president's job performance was 53%, and negative approval was 35%, similar to the week before. Positive responses that the three major mega-projects "will contribute to balanced regional development" were 57%, while negative responses that "regional disparities will widen further" were 26%. (최근 이재명 대통령 직무 평가는 나쁘지 않습니다. 7월10일 발표한 한국갤럽 정례 여론조사에서 대통령 직무 긍정 평가는 53%, 부정 평가는 35%로 1주일 전과 비슷했습니다. 3대 메가 프로젝트가 “지역 균형 발전에 도움이 될 것”이라는 긍정적 응답은 57%, “지역 간 격차가 더 커질 것”이라는 부정적 응답은 26%였습니다.)

However, the government's real estate policy is approaching a dangerous level. The rise in jeonse (lump-sum deposit) and monthly rents is severe. The Democratic Party is absorbed in internal power struggles, turning its back on people's livelihoods. (하지만 정부의 부동산 정책은 위험 수위에 다가서고 있습니다. 전·월세 상승은 심각합니다. 민주당은 민생을 외면한 채 당권 투쟁에 몰두하고 있습니다.)

Despite this, the gap in party support is large, with the Democratic Party at 42% and the People Power Party at 24%. Democratic Party support has not dropped from 41% immediately after the June 3rd election. People Power Party support, which rose to 29% right after the election, has been on a downward trend to 27%, 26%, and 24%. They have squandered all the support gained from winning the Seoul mayoral election. The People Power Party's support seems likely to fall further. There are two reasons. (그런데도 정당 지지도는 민주당 42%, 국민의힘 24%로 차이가 큽니다. 민주당 지지도는 6·3 선거 직후 41%에서 떨어지지 않고 있습니다. 국민의힘 지지도는 선거 직후 29%로 올라갔다가 27%, 26%, 24%로 내리막입니다. 서울시장 선거 승리로 얻은 지지도를 다 까먹은 것입니다. 국민의힘 지지도는 앞으로 더 빠질 것 같습니다. 이유는 두 가지입니다.)

First, the Yoon Seok-youl effect. (첫째, 윤석열 효과입니다.)

Former President Yoon Seok-youl is on trial for several cases. Just when the public is about to forget, former President Yoon Seok-youl's face appears on television. Whenever former President Yoon Seok-youl's face is seen, the People Power Party's support is bound to drop. (윤석열 전 대통령은 여러 개 사건으로 재판을 받고 있습니다. 국민이 잊을만하면 윤석열 전 대통령 얼굴이 텔레비전에 나타납니다. 윤석열 전 대통령 얼굴이 보일 때마다 국민의힘 지지도는 떨어질 수밖에 없습니다.)

On July 9th, the Supreme Court confirmed the lower court's sentence of seven years in prison for former President Yoon Seok-youl's obstruction of the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials (CIO). On the same day, former Presidential Security Service Chief Park Jong-joon, former Deputy Chief Kim Seong-hoon, and former Security Headquarters Chief Lee Kwang-woo, among other security service officials who obstructed the arrest, were also sentenced to prison terms in the first trial for special obstruction of public duty and were detained in court. (대법원은 7월9일 윤석열 전 대통령의 고위공직자범죄수사처 체포 방해 사건에 대해 징역 7년의 원심을 확정했습니다. 같은 날 박종준 전 경호처장, 김성훈 전 차장, 이광우 전 경호본부장 등 체포를 방해한 경호처 간부들도 특수공무집행방해 사건 1심에서 모두 실형을 선고받고 법정 구속됐습니다.)

Do you remember the 44 People Power Party lawmakers who gathered in front of the Hannam-dong presidential residence on January 6, 2025, vowing to prevent President Yoon Seok-youl's arrest? Since the Supreme Court has finally recognized the obstruction of arrest as a crime, I believe these individuals should apologize to the public even now. Yet, they are feigning ignorance and staying silent. It seems they have absolutely no sense of shame. (여러분은 2025년 1월6일 윤석열 대통령 체포를 저지하겠다며 한남동 공관 앞에 모였던 국민의힘 의원 44명을 기억하십니까? 대법원이 최종적으로 체포 방해를 유죄로 인정했으니 이들은 이제라도 대국민사과를 하는 것이 옳다고 봅니다. 그런데도 시치미를 뚝 떼고 침묵하고 있습니다. 도대체 부끄러움이라는 것을 전혀 모르는 것 같습니다.)

Second, the Jang Dong-hyuk effect. (둘째, 장동혁 효과입니다.)

The most core value of conservatism is responsibility. Without taking responsibility, it is not conservatism. Representative Jang Dong-hyuk did not take responsibility even for the defeat in the June 3rd election. (보수의 가장 핵심적인 가치는 책임입니다. 책임지지 않으면 보수가 아닙니다. 장동혁 대표는 6·3 선거 패배에도 책임지지 않았습니다.)

The most core attitude of conservatism is dignity. Conservatism without dignity is not conservatism. Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, during the 'vote counting station blockade protest' at Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul on July 7th, held up a placard that read, "Jae-myung, don't pick on a high school student, fight me." He mocked the incumbent president by using his first name in a disrespectful tone. Next time, he might hold up a placard with profanity. (보수의 가장 핵심적인 태도는 품격입니다. 품격 없는 보수는 보수가 아닙니다. 장동혁 대표는 7월7일 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 ‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’에서 “재명아 고등학생 말고 나랑 싸우자”고 쓴 팻말을 들었습니다. 현직 대통령의 이름을 부르며 반말로 조롱한 것입니다. 다음에는 욕설을 써서 팻말로 들 수도 있을 것 같습니다.)

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk said this on the New Daily TV YouTube channel on July 10th. (장동혁 대표는 7월10일 뉴데일리 티브이 유튜브에 출연해 이런 말을 했습니다.)

"They talk about not doing 'subtraction politics,' but someone who shoots at our own side is the biggest minus. There is no greater subtraction than that. Telling the party leader to step down is subtraction politics. Clearly, acts of insubordination are like shooting at our own side in a war and helping the enemy." (“뺄셈 정치를 하지 말라고 하는데, 우리 편을 향해서 총을 쏘는 사람은 가장 큰 마이너스다. 그보다 더 뺄셈은 없다. 대표한테 당신 물러나라고 하는 게 뺄셈 정치다. 명백한 해당 행위는 전쟁에서 우리 편을 향해서 총을 쏘는 것, 그리고 적을 돕는 것이다.”)

"Lawmaker Han Dong-hoon was expelled for criminal acts, not for acts of insubordination." (“한동훈 의원은 범죄 행위로 제명을 당한 것이지, 해당 행위로 제명당한 것이 아니다.”)

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's remarks are truly astonishing. Across both ruling and opposition parties, demands for the resignation of party leadership are commonplace. Even in the era of imperial-style chairpersons, demands for leadership resignation were not punished. If Lawmaker Han Dong-hoon's bulletin board controversy was a criminal act, they should not have disciplined him but reported him to investigative authorities to hold him criminally accountable. (장동혁 대표의 발언은 참으로 놀라운 것입니다. 여야를 막론하고 정당에서 지도부 사퇴 요구는 일상사입니다. 제왕적 총재들이 지배하던 시대에도 지도부 사퇴 요구를 징계하지 않았습니다. 한동훈 의원의 게시판 논란이 범죄 행위라면 징계를 할 것이 아니라 수사기관에 고발해서 형사 책임을 묻는 게 마땅합니다.)

The patience of conservative-leaning media also seems to be running out. The title of Kim Dae-jung's column in the July 7th edition of the Chosun Ilbo was, "People Power Party, Let's Go to a Confidence Vote for the Party Leader." The title of its July 7th editorial was, "The Disciplinary Action of the People Power Party Attempts to Defy the Choice of the People from a Month Ago." The title of its July 11th editorial was, "Representative Jang, Is the Choice of Voters in Busan North-Gap a Joke?" (보수 성향 언론의 인내심도 서서히 바닥에 이르고 있는 것 같습니다. 조선일보 7월7일 치 김대중 칼럼의 제목은 “국힘, 당대표 신임투표로 가자”였습니다. 7월7일 치 사설 제목은 “국민의힘 징계, 한 달 전 국민의 선택에 맞서려 한다”였습니다. 7월11일 치 사설 제목은 “장 대표는 부산 북갑 유권자 선택이 우스운 건가”였습니다.)

The title of the July 7th editorial of Munhwa Ilbo was also, "Dozens of Lawmakers Are Subject to Discipline... Should at Least Hold a Confidence Vote for Jang." The Dong-A Ilbo ran a column by Kim Soon-deok on July 9th titled, "Does Jang Dong-hyuk Have the Right to Oppose the 'Gag Law'?" (문화일보 7월7일 치 사설 제목도 “의원 수십 명이 징계 대상이라니…장 신임투표라도 해야”였습니다. 동아일보는 7월9일 치에 “장동혁, ‘입틀막법’ 반대할 자격 있나”라는 제목의 김순덕 칼럼을 실었습니다.)

However, all these advices and reprimands are like 'reading sutras to a cow's ears.' Representative Jang Dong-hyuk appears to have no intention of stepping down. It is said he doesn't even read newspapers. (그러나 이런 충고와 질책이 모두 ‘쇠귀에 경 읽기’입니다. 장동혁 대표는 사퇴할 생각이 전혀 없는 것으로 보입니다. 신문도 아예 읽지 않는 것 같다고 합니다.)

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk has another source of confidence: the hardcore responsible party members of the People Power Party. These hardcore responsible party members of the People Power Party maintain an adversarial, mutually coexisting relationship with the hardcore dues-paying party members of the Democratic Party. It is a tactic of strongly criticizing rivals and holding on based on that hostility and hatred. The paradox of political polarization is that as hostility and hatred deepen, the positions of the extreme wings become more entrenched. (장동혁 대표가 믿는 구석은 따로 있습니다. 국민의힘 강성 책임당원들입니다. 국민의힘 강성 책임당원들은 민주당 강성 권리당원들과 적대적 상호 공존 관계를 맺고 있습니다. 경쟁 상대를 강하게 비판하면서 그 적대감과 증오를 기반으로 버티는 전술입니다. 적대와 증오가 깊어질수록 양극단 세력의 입지는 단단해지는 것이 정치 양극화의 역설입니다.)

A lawmaker from the People Power Party's Yeongnam region constituency described Representative Jang Dong-hyuk this way. (국민의힘의 영남 지역구 한 의원은 장동혁 대표를 이렇게 묘사했습니다.)

"Now, only malice remains. I shouldn't say this, but as some say, if he were a complete corpse, it wouldn't matter, but the problem is he's become a zombie walking around. He is full of spite. I've also memorized 'fraudulent election, re-election, same-day voting, hand-counting' because he says it so much. He is now trapped in that alone." (“지금 악만 남은 거다. 이런 말 하면 안 되지만 누구 말대로 아예 시체면 상관이 없는데 좀비가 돼서 돌아다니니까 문제다. 독기가 가득하다. ‘부정선거 재선거 당일투표 수개표’ 하도 많이 들어서 나도 외웠다. 지금 거기에만 갇혀 있는 거다.”)

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk held an on-site briefing on the 'June 3rd Disenfranchisement Incident' in Busan on July 12th. He also visited the assembly site at Seomyeon Heart Plaza on Jungang-daero in Busanjin-gu. He plans to visit Gwangju this week and conclude his local tour schedule in Daegu. I am worried about what placard he will hold up and what he will say. (장동혁 대표는 7월12일 부산에서 ‘6·3 참정권 박탈 사태’ 현장 간담회를 합니다. 부산진구 중앙대로 서면 하트광장 집회 현장도 방문합니다. 이번 주 중 광주를 방문하고 대구에서 지방 순회 일정을 마무리할 예정입니다. 어떤 팻말을 들고 나설지, 무슨 말을 할지 걱정입니다.)

What will ultimately happen to Representative Jang Dong-hyuk? Former People Power Party Emergency Response Committee Chair Kim Jong-in appeared on CBS Radio's 'Park Jae-hong's One Match Show' on July 10th and said this. (장동혁 대표는 결국 어떻게 될까요? 김종인 전 국민의힘 비대위원장은 7월10일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박재홍의 한판승부’에 출연해 이렇게 말했습니다.)

"Representative Jang Dong-hyuk says he will never step down even if a resolution to oust him is passed at the general meeting of lawmakers, but if it comes to that, as a politician, he will inevitably experience a very tragic situation. Ultimately, a situation will arise where he steps down due to the power of party members or lawmakers." (“장동혁 대표는 의원총회에서 내쫓는 결의를 해도 절대 안 물러난다고 하지만 그런 상황까지 가면 정치인으로서 굉장히 좀 비극적인 상황을 겪을 수밖에 없을 것이다. 결국 당원이나 의원들의 힘에 의해서 물러나는 그런 상황이 올 것이다.”)

However, contrary to former Chair Kim Jong-in's observation, the likelihood of Representative Jang Dong-hyuk being ousted by party members does not seem very high in the immediate future. (그러나 김종인 전 위원장의 관측처럼 장동혁 대표가 당원들에 의해 쫓겨날 가능성은 당장은 그리 크지 않아 보입니다.)

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk won the final round of the party convention last August with a vote share of 50.27%. Although he lagged far behind candidate Kim Moon-soo in the general public opinion poll, he won by obtaining 52.88% in the party member electoral college vote, which reflected 80%. Most of the responsible party members who supported candidate Jang Dong-hyuk at that time remain. We must also assume that a significant number of the 50,000 Shincheonji followers who joined the People Power Party under the direction of Chairman Lee Man-hee are still there. (장동혁 대표는 지난해 8월 전당대회 결선에서 50.27% 득표율로 승리했습니다. 일반 국민 여론조사에서 김문수 후보에게 크게 뒤졌지만 80%를 반영한 당원 선거인단 투표에서 52.88%를 득표해 승리했습니다. 당시 장동혁 후보를 지지했던 책임당원들이 대부분 그대로 있습니다. 이만희 총회장의 지시로 국민의힘에 입당한 신천지 신도 5만명 가운데 상당수도 그대로 있다고 봐야 합니다.)

If a vote of all party members were held in this state, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk could be reconfirmed. He could even complete his term until August next year and, if he seeks re-election, be re-elected as party leader. What would happen to the People Power Party then? Would its approval ratings rise? There's no way. The People Power Party's approval rating will plummet. A rush of defections among rational conservative-leaning party members will begin. Lawmakers will also defect en masse. (이런 상태에서 전당원투표를 하면 장동혁 대표가 재신임될 수 있습니다. 심지어 내년 8월까지 대표 임기를 마치고 연임에 도전하면 대표로 다시 선출될 수도 있습니다. 그럼 국민의힘은 어떻게 될까요? 지지도가 올라갈까요? 그럴 리가요. 국민의힘 지지도는 수직 낙하할 것입니다. 합리적 보수 성향 당원들의 탈당 러시가 시작될 것입니다. 의원들도 집단 탈당할 것입니다.)

A lawmaker's top priority is to be elected in the next general election. If they remain in the People Power Party under Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's system, defeat is certain, so they will not stay idle. Eventually, the People Power Party will degenerate into a minor party and then disappear. (국회의원의 최우선 목표는 다음 총선에서 당선되는 것입니다. 장동혁 대표 체제의 국민의힘에 남아 있으면 낙선이 분명한데 의원들이 가만히 있을 리 없습니다. 결국 국민의힘은 군소정당으로 전락했다가 사라질 것입니다.)

There is actually a precedent for this. Ahead of the 12th general election on February 12, 1985, the two Kims, Kim Young-sam and Kim Dae-jung, led by Chairman Lee Min-woo, founded the New Korean Democratic Party (NKDP). The NKDP caused a sensation, overtaking the 'government-controlled opposition' Democratic Korea Party and the National Party to become the primary opposition party. (실제로 그런 전례가 있었습니다. 1985년 2·12 12대 총선을 앞두고 김영삼·김대중 양 김 씨는 이민우 총재를 앞세워 신한민주당(신민당)을 창당했습니다. 신민당은 돌풍을 일으켰고 ‘관제 야당’ 민한당과 국민당을 제치고 제1 야당이 됐습니다.)

However, in December 1986, Chairman Lee Min-woo suddenly announced the 'Lee Min-woo Initiative,' conditionally accepting the Chun Doo-hwan regime's constitutional amendment for a cabinet system. In protest, lawmakers from Kim Young-sam's Sangdo-dong faction and Kim Dae-jung's Donggyo-dong faction defected en masse to found the Unification Democratic Party. The NKDP shrunk to about ten seats and then failed to elect a single candidate in the 1988 general election, leading to its registration being cancelled. (그러나 1986년 12월 이민우 총재는 돌연 전두환 정권의 의원내각제 개헌을 조건부로 수용하는 ‘이민우 구상’을 발표했습니다. 이에 반발한 김영삼의 상도동계와 김대중의 동교동계 의원들이 무더기로 탈당해 통일민주당을 창당했습니다. 신민당은 10여석으로 쪼그라들었다가 1988년 총선에서 당선자를 한 명도 내지 못해 등록 취소됐습니다.)

It is not entirely impossible for the People Power Party to seize a chance for revival. If approval ratings continue to fall like this, Supreme Council members Shin Dong-wook and Kim Jae-won might change their stance. If the supreme council members resign, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk must step down. The same applies if Representative Jang Dong-hyuk faces a vote of no confidence in a party-wide ballot. (국민의힘이 회생의 기회를 잡을 가능성이 전혀 없는 것은 아닙니다. 지금처럼 지지도가 계속 떨어지면 신동욱·김재원 최고위원이 태도를 바꿀 수도 있습니다. 최고위원들이 사퇴하면 장동혁 대표는 물러나야 합니다. 전당원투표에서 장동혁 대표가 불신임당해도 마찬가지입니다.)

If that happens, the People Power Party will transition to an Emergency Response Committee system. Ahead of the 2028 general election, an alliance could be formed involving Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, Lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, Lawmaker Lee Jun-seok, Lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo, and former Lawmaker Yoo Seung-min. Unlike presidential elections, a kind of collective leadership system is possible for general elections. (그렇게 되면 국민의힘은 비상대책위원회 체제로 넘어갑니다. 2028년 총선을 앞두고 오세훈 서울시장, 한동훈 의원, 이준석 의원, 안철수 의원, 유승민 전 의원 등의 연대가 이뤄질 수 있습니다. 총선은 대선과 달리 일종의 집단지도체제가 가능합니다.)

This is the only way for the People Power Party to become competitive in the 2028 general election. Of course, this is a scenario only possible if Representative Jang Dong-hyuk resigns in any case. This means Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation is the only way to save conservatism. What is your opinion? (국민의힘이 2028년 총선에서 경쟁력을 갖추는 유일한 방안입니다. 물론 어떤 경우든 장동혁 대표가 사퇴해야 가능한 시나리오입니다. 장동혁 대표 사퇴가 보수를 살리는 유일한 길이라는 의미입니다. 여러분은 어떻게 생각하십니까?)

Senior Political Correspondent shy99@hani.co.kr (정치부 선임기자 shy99@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Did you see that, Jaemyung?" Jang Dong-hyuk uses informal speech again... "'Dong-hyuk-a' you wouldn't say" Criticism even within the People Power Party (“재명아 봤지?” 장동혁 또 반말…“‘똥혁아’ 안 하잖아” 국힘서도 비판)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, was spotted holding a sign during the "Jamsil Counting Station Blockade Protest" that read "Did you see that, Jaemyung?" again using informal speech to refer to President Lee Jaemyung. Despite criticism from political circles that referring to the president informally is "inappropriate," he appears unfazed. <<> Representative Jang appeared at the "Counting Station Blockade Protest" in front of the Olympic Handball Gymnasium in Songpa-gu, Seoul on the 11th, holding a sign that read "Did you see that, Jaemyung? Heard it? Then you have to accept a special counsel, right?" Previously, on the 7th, he sparked controversy at the same protest by holding a sign saying "Jaemyung, fight me, not high school students," and this time he wrote, "Did you see that, Jaemyung?" Jang was also seen waving a heart-shaped cheering stick with the Taegeukgi and chanting "Election fraud, re-election, same-day voting, manual recount." <<> Jang was also seen holding signs that said, "Is my vote a joke? You're the joke!", "Olympic Park is hot, right? Wanna hang out with a friend next week?", and "The youth of Olympic Park, the Taegeukgi, the national anthem. This is our future!" Kim Min-soo, a Supreme Council member of the People Power Party, stood next to Jang, holding a sign reading "Olympic Park. There are those who haven't been, but none who came only once," and chanting slogans. Based on the distinctive calligraphy style, all the signs are presumed to have been written by Jang himself. <<> Despite ongoing criticism from political circles over Jang's earlier sign reading "Jaemyung, fight me," Jang appears undeterred, continuing his pattern of "informal speech politics." On the 8th, Representative Park Ji-won of the Democratic Party of Korea pointed out, "Even if harsh words fly back and forth in politics, isn't it a principle to at least show respect to the head of state, the president?" On the 9th, Han Byeong-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader, criticized it as "the lowest form of reckless behavior" and said, "Representative Jang's vulgar and abusive politics have crossed the line." <<> Internal criticism within the People Power Party has also emerged. Kim Geun-sik, the head of the Songpa-gu Byeong district party chapter for the People Power Party, said on Facebook on the 11th, "No matter how much the president has done wrong, 'Jaemyung-a' is not the language of politics. It's just the excrement of abusive language spewed by far-right extremists." He added, "No matter how angry I am, I don't mock the leader by calling him 'Dong-hyuk-a'." He continued, "That is the dignity of politics. That is the depth of politics. Please come to your senses and don't be bound by the language of extremists." <<> Yoon Hee-seok, a former spokesperson for the People Power Party and a member of the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction, also evaluated the sign as "inappropriate" on the 8th during MBC Radio's "Jo Seung-won's News High Kick." He added, "Even just calling (the president) by his name is considered a derogatory term. When you mix derogatory terms while making an argument against a political opponent, regardless of how reasonable the argument's content is, it doesn't register. Only the derogatory terms come through." <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 ‘잠실 개표소 봉쇄 시위’에서 “재명아 봤지”라며 재차 반말로 이재명 대통령을 지칭하는 손팻말을 들고 있는 모습이 포착됐다. 이 대통령을 향한 반말 호명에 정치권에서 “부적절하다”는 비판들이 나왔지만, 아랑곳하지 않는 모양새다.)

item.title: North Korea Vows to “Continue Safeguarding North Korea-China Common Interests”… Reports on Pak Thae-song-Li Qiang Talks (북한 “북-중 공동이익 수호 계속”…박태성-리창 회담 보도)
item.description:
On the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation, and Mutual Assistance (North Korea-China Friendship Treaty), North Korean Cabinet Premier Pak Thae-song, currently visiting China, discussed matters concerning the development of North Korea-China exchange and cooperation with Chinese Premier Li Qiang, the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 12th. (북중 우호협력 및 상호원조 조약(북중 우호조약) 체결 65돌 맞아 중국을 방문 중인 박태성 북한 내각총리가 리창 중국 국무원 총리와 북중 교류협력 발전에 관한 사안을 논의했다고 12일 조선중앙통신이 보도했다.)

The agency reported that Premier Pak held talks with Premier Li the previous day at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where “issues related to expanding and developing exchanges and cooperation in various fields based on the agreements reached during the historic summit in Pyongyang between the top leaders of North Korea and China were discussed.” KCNA said that during the talks, Premier Pak referred to the North Korea-China Friendship Treaty as “a solid political and legal guarantee that strongly promotes the development of friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries,” adding that “the complex international political situation demands that the spirit of the treaty, centered on unity, cooperation, and the protection of common interests, continue to be highly upheld.” <<> Premier Li also emphasized that “China and North Korea are neighboring countries sharing a common destiny, protecting and helping each other,” and stressed the need to “continue upholding the spirit of the (North Korea-China Friendship Treaty), maintain close high-level exchanges, and expand and develop political mutual trust and practical cooperation.” <<> Last month, Chairman Kim Jong-un and President Xi Jinping held a summit in Pyongyang, pledging exchange and cooperation in diplomatic, military, and economic fields, along with high-level exchanges. With Premier Pak’s visit to China as an opportunity, it was anticipated that economic cooperation measures, such as Chinese tourism to North Korea, the opening of the new Yalu River Bridge, and the expansion of border trade ports, would be discussed. <<> KCNA also reported that Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi exchanged congratulatory messages on the 11th. According to KCNA, Minister Choe expressed to Minister Wang “the willingness to further strengthen communication and cooperation between the foreign ministries to highly uphold the noble intentions of the top leaders of North Korea and China and to develop the North Korea-China friendly cooperative relationship into the most robust and strategic example of relations between socialist countries.” Minister Wang also stated in the message that “China is willing to firmly implement the important common understanding of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries and to continuously strive to consolidate, deepen, and develop the traditional China-North Korea friendly cooperative relationship.” <<> KCNA also reported that Premier Pak and the North Korean delegation, currently visiting Beijing, participated in a welcoming ceremony on the 11th. On the Chinese side, Premier Li, along with State Council member and Secretary-General of the State Council Wu Zhenglong, Chairman of the National Development and Reform Commission Zheng Shanjie, and Minister of Commerce Wang Wentao, received the delegation. Premier Pak, along with Workers’ Party of Korea Central Committee Secretary Kim Song-nam and other members of the North Korean delegation, reviewed the honor guard of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army together with Premier Li. <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (통신은 박 총리가 전날 베이징 인민대회당에서 리 총리와 회담하고 “조중 최고수뇌분들께서 역사적인 평양 상봉에서 이룩하신 합의에 따라 각 분야에서 교류와 협력을 확대, 발전시켜 나가기 위한 문제들이 토의되었다”고 보도했다. 회담에서 박 총리는 북중 우호조약이 “두 나라 사이의 친선협조 관계 발전을 강력히 추동해 나가는 굳건한 정치적 및 법률적 담보”라며 “복잡다단한 국제정치 정세는 단결과 협조, 공동의 이익 수호를 핵(핵심)으로 하는 조약의 정신을 계속 높이 발양해 나갈 것을 요구하고 있다”고 말했다고 통신은 보도했다.)

item.title: Ahn Cheol-soo: "I oppose Han Dong-hoon's return to the party, he shouldn't even come near... If he forms a new party, I'll cheer him on." (안철수 “한동훈 복당 반대, 얼씬도 말라…창당한다면 응원”)
item.description:
People Power Party lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo stated on the 12th, "I formally oppose the return of Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon to the People Power Party." This is a response to Han's accusations of "false incitement" regarding his recent testimony at the trial of Daegu Mayor Choo Kyung-ho, who faces charges of engaging in critical duties related to insurrection. Some interpret this as the beginning of a competition for conservative leadership. (안철수 국민의힘 의원이 12일 “한동훈 (무소속) 의원의 국민의힘 복당을 공식적으로 반대한다”고 말했다. 최근 추경호 대구시장의 내란중요임무종사 혐의 재판에 출석해 증언한 것과 관련, 한 의원이 “거짓 선동”이라고 몰아붙인 데 대한 반응인데 이를 계기로 보수 주도권 경쟁을 벌이는 것이란 해석도 나온다.)

During a press conference at the National Assembly that day, Ahn said, "After testifying as a witness in Mayor Choo's trial this time, I have encountered reactions I never imagined. Lawmaker Han has framed me as if I engaged in distortion and incitement. Turning testimony that stated facts into falsehoods is a clear case of spreading false information and defamation," he argued. (안 의원은 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “이번에 추 시장 재판에 증인으로 진술한 후 상상도 하지 못했던 반응을 접했다”며 “한 의원은 마치 제가 왜곡과 선동을 한 것처럼 몰아갔다. 사실을 사실대로 말한 증언을 허위로 둔갑시키는 것이야말로 명백한 허위사실 유포이자 명예훼손”이라고 반발했다.)

On the 8th, Ahn appeared as a witness at Mayor Choo's trial at the Seoul Central District Court and testified, "I heard that it was (then-leader) Han Dong-hoon who first suggested gathering at the party headquarters because police were blocking access to the National Assembly. Choo Kyung-ho simply went along with that call to gather at the party headquarters." He added, "It is not true that then-leader Han said to gather at the National Assembly, but then-floor leader Choo Kyung-ho ignored that and ordered people to the party headquarters." In response, Han had refuted this on the 9th, stating, "Just because time has passed, there should be no attempts to distort objective facts. It seems he is distorting what happened at 12 o'clock to fit what happened at 11 o'clock." (안 의원은 지난 8일 서울중앙지방법원에서 열린 추 시장의 재판에 증인으로 나와 “경찰이 국회 출입을 막고 있으니 당사로 모이자고 먼저 한 게 한동훈 (당시) 대표라고 들었다”며 “추경호는 그에 맞춰 당사로 모이라고 한 것”이라고 증언했다. 그러면서 “한동훈 대표가 국회에 모이라고 했는데 추경호 (당시) 원내대표가 이를 무시하고 당사로 모이라고 했다는 것은 사실이 아니다”라고 했다. 이에 대해 한 의원은 지난 9일 “시간이 지났다고 객관적 사실들을 왜곡하려는 시도가 있어선 안 된다”며 “11시에 있었던 일을 12시에 맞춰 왜곡해 말씀하시는 것 같다”고 반박한 바 있다.)

Regarding Han's rebuttal, Ahn told reporters that same day, "I have not confused the time at all. I can show all the evidence of what the party's official records say and what I was doing at what time." Ahn said, "In fact, despite being summoned as a witness multiple times in the same trial, Han himself has not appeared even once. If he has something to say, he should stop hiding behind an 'absence from home' excuse and appear in court to testify." (안 의원은 이날 기자들과 만나 한 의원의 반박에 대해 “저는 전혀 (시간을) 혼동하지 않았다. 당의 공식 자료와 내가 몇 시에 뭘 했는지 자료를 전부 보여줄 수 있다”고 말했다. 안 의원은 “정작 한 의원 본인은 같은 재판에 증인으로 수차례나 소환되고도 단 한 번도 출석하지 않았다. 할 말이 있다면 ‘폐문부재’ 뒤에 숨지 말고 법정에 출석해서 증언하면 될 일”이라고 말했다.)

Ahn further stated, "Even while Han is outside the party, this is the level of trouble. It's as clear as day what would happen if he returns to the party. The entire party would fall into factional strife and exhausting internal conflict, and the damage would be borne entirely by the conservative and right-wing citizens. The election victory would be unattainable, and we would spiral into a situation of catastrophe." Ahn added toward Han, "Now, please don't even think about coming near our party. If you're considering forming a new party, I'll cheer you on." (안 의원은 그러면서 “한 의원이 당 밖에 있는데도 이 정도인데, 그가 복당하면 어떻게 될지 불 보듯 뻔하다”며 “당 전체는 계파 갈등과 소모적 내전에 빠질 것이며, 그 피해는 고스란히 보수 및 우파 시민 전체가 떠안게 될 것이다. 총선 승리는 엄두도 못 내는, 파국의 상황으로 치달을 것”이라고 주장했다. 안 의원은 한 의원을 향해 “이제 우리 당에는 얼씬도 하지 말기 바란다. 혹시 창당을 생각하고 있다면 응원하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Moo-sung "Jang Dong-hyuk is taking to the streets because he has no place in the party" (김무성 “장동혁, 당에 설 자리 없어서 장외로 도는 것”)
item.description:
Former leader of the Saenuri Party (predecessor to the People Power Party), Kim Moo-sung, criticized recent nationwide tours of the suffrage rally by current People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, saying, "The party leader is taking to the streets because he has no place to stand in the party." (김무성 새누리당(국민의힘 전신) 전 대표가 최근 장동혁 국민의힘 대표의 참정권 집회 전국 순회와 관련해 “당 대표가 당에 설 자리가 없으니까 장외로 도는 것”이라고 비판했다.)

Appearing on TV Chosun’s 'Strong Opponents' on the 11th, the former leader Kim addressed Jang’s multiple attendances at the suffrage rally held at Seoul Olympic Park, where he wore a hat and mask, stating, "Even if he attends the rally wearing a hat and mask, he is still the current party leader," and added, "The public sees everything Jang Dong-hyuk says and does outside as the words and actions of the People Power Party leader. I urge him to exercise restraint." (김 전 대표는 지난 11일 티브이(TV)조선 ‘강적들’에 출연해 장 대표가 서울 올림픽공원에서 열리는 참정권 집회에 모자와 마스크를 쓰고 여러 차례 참석한 데 대해 “모자, 마스크를 쓰고 집회에 나간다 하더라도 현직 당 대표자”라며 “국민은 장동혁 대표가 장외에 나가서 하는 모든 언행을 국민의힘 대표의 언행으로 본다. 자제해달라”고 했다.)

He continued, "I believe there was no election fraud," and said, "Our party has been deeply divided because of those obsessed with election fraud delusions. Just as things were being somewhat sorted out, the unprecedented shortage of ballot papers reignited (the election fraud claims)." (그는 이어 “부정선거는 없다고 생각한다”며 “우리 당이 부정선거 망상론자들 때문에 굉장히 분열됐다. 어느 정도 정리되는 과정에 이번 투표용지 부족사태라는 있을 수 없는 일이 벌어지면서 (부정선거론이) 다시 불붙었다”고 했다.)

Former leader Kim also criticized the disciplinary drive against pro-Han (Han Dong-hoon) and anti-Jang Dong-hyuk lawmakers. (김 전 대표는 또 친한계와 반장동혁계 의원들에 대한 징계 드라이브도 비판했다.)

He said, "Leader Jang doesn’t have the power to impose discipline. He has already lost his leadership," and added, "In the end, he keeps moving toward the path that hastens his own downfall." (그는 “장 대표가 징계할 수 있는 힘이 없다. 이미 지도력을 잃었다”며 “결국 자기 명을 재촉하는 길을 자꾸 가고 있다”고 했다.)

He further stated, "The party’s ethics committee disciplined lawmaker Bae Hyun-jin and former supreme council member Kim Jong-hyuk, but the court didn’t accept it. If so, the ethics committee that made the mistaken discipline should be disbanded, and those (ethics committee members) should be disciplined instead. But for that same group to again impose discipline solely for the party leader’s benefit is ultimately dividing the party," adding, "As a result, (Leader Jang) himself could face discipline." He also said, "Han Dong-hoon should be reinstated into the party, and (the party) should merge with Lee Jun-seok (leader of the Reform Party). Aren’t they people who were unjustly expelled?" item.title: [Breaking] One missing naval crew member... 50 km off the coast of Gyeongjin, East Sea ([속보] 해군 함정 승조원 1명 실종…동해 거진 50㎞ 해상)
item.description:
The Navy announced on the morning of the 12th that one crew member from a naval vessel, which was conducting patrol duties approximately 50 km east of Gyeongjin in the East Sea, has gone missing. (해군이 12일 오전 동해 거진 동방 50여㎞ 해상에서 경비임무를 수행 중이던 해군 함정 승조원 1명이 실종됐다고 밝혔다.)

The Navy added, "We are currently deploying ships and aircraft in coordination with the Coast Guard to search for the missing person," and "We are also disseminating the situation to fishing vessels operating in the area and nearby commercial ships to cooperate in the search." (해군은 “현재 해경과 합동으로 함정과 항공기를 투입하여 실종자를 탐색 중”이라며 “조업 중인 어선, 인근 상선 등에도 상황을 전파하고 수색을 협조하고 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

The Ministry of National Defense reported that Minister of National Ahn Gyu-baek received a report on the incident this morning and "instructed that all efforts be made to rescue the missing person as quickly and safely as possible, while maintaining an active cooperative system with relevant agencies such as the Coast Guard." (안규백 국방부 장관도 이날 오전 사고 관련 보고를 받고 “최대한 신속하고 안전하게 실종자 구조에 최선을 다할 것과 해경 등 유관기관과도 적극적인 공조체계를 유지할 것을 지시했다”고 국방부는 전했다.)
