item.title: Cho Kuk shouts "Risense, yahoo!" – "I never said Risense is about Ilbe" (“리센느 야호!” 외친 조국 “리센느 일베라 한 적 없어”)
item.description:
Amid controversy over whether girl group Risense member Woni's remark "Museopno" was an "Ilbe-style expression" (referencing the far-right online community Ilbe), former leader of the Innovation Party Cho Kuk stated, "I never said Risense is about Ilbe," and added, "I regret that my writing was used as an opportunity to hurt Risense and its fans." (걸그룹 리센느 멤버 원이가 “무섭노”라고 말한 것을 두고 ‘일베(일간베스트저장소)식 표현’ 논란이 일었던 가운데 조국 전 조국혁신당 대표가 “리센느가 일베라고 말한 적이 전혀 없다”며 “제 글이 리센느와 팬 여러분께 상처를 주는 계기로 활용돼 유감”이라고 했다.)

On the 12th, former leader Cho posted on Facebook: "My heart was heavy due to the aftermath of my raising an issue about the use of Ilbe-style 'no'—which looks similar to the Gyeongsang dialect but is clearly different. What I lamented was the spread, without any criticism, of the Ilbe-style 'no' that began with mocking former President Roh Moo-hyun across our society and the tolerance of this phenomenon." (조 전 대표는 12일 페이스북에 “경상도 말과 유사해 보이지만 분명히 다른, 일베식 ‘노’ 사용에 대한 저의 문제 제기의 여파로 마음이 무거웠다”며 “제가 개탄했던 것은 고 노무현 대통령님을 조롱하는 데서 시작된 일베식 ‘노’ 사용이 아무런 비판 없이 우리 사회 전반으로 확산되고 이를 묵인하는 현상이었다”고 했다.)

Former leader Cho said, "However, I found that my raising this issue was being interpreted as criticism of Risense. I never mentioned or targeted Risense in any of my writings. I never said that Risense is about Ilbe." He continued, "I am very sorry and regret that my writing was used as an opportunity to hurt Risense and its fans. Also, after listening to my daughter and young staff members, I have come to reflect on the need to pay more careful attention to the language and culture of the younger generation and the context in which it is used. I applaud Risense's struggles and achievements and sincerely hope they receive even more love on bigger stages in the future." Former leader Cho added, "Risense, yahoo!" <<> Earlier, on the 5th, former leader Cho had posted on Facebook: "There are people who defend the use of 'no' at the end of interrogative sentences by Ilbe, which began as a way to mock President Roh Moo-hyun, claiming it is also used in Busan and the Yeongnam region. From my observation, Ilbe mechanically attaches 'no' to standard language." Prior to that, a YouTube video released on the 28th of last month showed Woni, who is from Geoje City in South Gyeongsang Province, saying "Museopno," sparking controversy over whether it was an Ilbe-style expression. Cho's remarks had amplified the controversy. <<> Regarding former leader Cho's statement of "regret," People Power Party lawmaker Kim Min-jeon criticized him on Facebook that day, saying, "And now you say you never said Risense is about Ilbe?" Kim added, "Let all the Wonis not lose heart and walk proudly!" <<> Choi Eun-seok, the senior deputy spokesperson for the People Power Party's floor leadership, also issued a commentary titled "Stop your petty excuses, former leader Cho, and restrain yourself," criticizing Cho's remarks as "sophistry." Deputy spokesperson Choi said, "The member of Risense suffered unexpected hardship due to this controversy sparked by former leader Cho. While the actual person involved is suffering, the instigator is trying to escape by saying, 'I never targeted them,' with his hands behind his back. This is not a genuine apology. It is merely a pathetic excuse and justification to defend himself in the midst of a political controversy." <<> Jeon Gwang-jun, reporter light@hani.co.kr (조 전 대표는 “그런데 저의 문제 제기가 리센느에 대한 비난으로 받아들여지고 있음을 알게 됐다”며 “저는 어떤 글에서도 리센느를 언급하거나 겨냥한 적이 없다. 리센느가 일베라고 말한 적도 전혀 없다”고 말했다. 이어 “제 글이 리센느와 팬 여러분께 상처를 주는 계기로 활용돼 매우 유감이며 안타깝다. 또한 제 딸과 젊은 당직자들의 이야기를 들으며, 젊은 세대의 언어와 문화, 그리고 그것이 사용되는 맥락을 더욱 세심하게 살펴야 한다는 점도 성찰하게 됐다”며 “리센느의 분투와 성취에 큰 박수를 보내며, 앞으로 더 큰 무대에서 더 많은 사랑을 받기를 진심으로 응원한다”고 했다. 조 전 대표는 “리센느, 야호!”라고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae targets Kim Min-seok’s past: “The worst self-serving politics is helping another party’s candidate” (정청래, 김민석 과거 겨냥 “최악 자기정치는 남의 당 후보 돕기”)
item.description:
Ahead of the August 17th national convention, conflict within the Democratic Party of Korea over the "primary rules," including the preferential voting system and the one-person-one-vote system, is intensifying, with leadership contenders engaged in sharp verbal sparring. (8·17 전당대회를 앞둔 더불어민주당에서 선호투표제와 1인1표제 등 ‘경선 룰’을 둘러싼 갈등이 격화하는 가운데, 당권 주자들은 날카로운 신경전을 이어갔다.)

Former Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae said on the 12th, targeting former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who is competing for the party leadership, “The worst form of self-serving politics is the old-style politics of leaving the party to run as an independent or helping candidates from another party during elections.” In a post on his Facebook, he said, “Even though I was unfairly cut off and lost my nomination, I led the ‘Deeper Crush Campaign Team’ running for the party’s victory. I prioritized the party over myself.” He added, “Who practiced self-serving politics?” This was a refutation of Kim’s ongoing criticism that Jung has caused confusion within the party and government through self-serving politics. Jung’s reference to “the worst self-serving politics” appears to be aimed at Kim Min-seok, who, during the 2002 presidential election, advocated for the unification of candidates Roh Moo-hyun and Chung Mong-joon and participated in the activities of the “Candidate Unification Council.” At that time, Kim left the party and joined the Chung Mong-joon camp. (정청래 더불어민주당 전 대표는 12일 당대표 경쟁을 하고 있는 김민석 전 국무총리를 겨냥해 “최악의 자기정치는 선거 때 탈당해서 무소속 출마하거나 남의 당 후보를 돕는 구태정치”라고 말했다. 그는 자신의 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “나는 억울한 컷오프로 공천탈락 했어도 당의 승리를 위해 ‘더컸유세단’을 이끌며 뛰었다. 선당후사했다”며 “누가 자기정치를 했는가?”라고 물었다. 김 전 총리가 자신을 향해 ‘자기정치’로 당과 정부를 혼선에 빠트렸다고 비판해 온 것을 재차 반박한 것이다. 정 전 대표가 ‘최악의 자기정치’라고 말한 것은 2002년 대선 당시 당시 노무현·정몽준 후보 단일화를 주장하면서 ‘후보단일화협의회(후단협)’ 활동을 했던 김 전 총리를 겨냥한 것으로 보인다. 당시 김 전 총리는 탈당해 정몽준 캠프에 합류했다.)

Kim said at a “YouTuber Q&A” event held at a small conference room in the National Assembly Members’ Office Building on the same day, “If you are a Democratic Party member standing on a normal foundation, no one should engage in slander, false information, or disparaging terms against fellow party politicians during discussions or debates with party members, especially when knowing the truth.” He added, “From today onward, if negative defamation against me continues, I will regard it as coming from fake party members and deal with it thoroughly.” This appeared to be aimed at Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon, a close ally of Jung Cheong-rae, who has repeatedly mentioned “cold medicine on the day of martial law” in relation to Kim. (김 전 총리는 이날 국회 의원회관 소회의실에서 연 ‘유튜버 백문백답’ 행사에서 “정상적인 뿌리 위에 선 민주당 당원이라면 어떤 분들도 당원들과의 토론·논쟁과정에서 당내 정치인을 향해 알면서도 거짓으로 (비방)하거나 허위사실 유포, 멸칭은 없을 것”이라며 “오늘 이후로는 저에 대한 네거티브 명예훼손이 계속되면 가짜당원으로 보고 철저하게 대처하겠다”고 말했다. 자신을 향해 ‘계엄 당일 감기약’ 등을 지속적으로 거론해 온 친정청래계 이성윤 최고의원을 겨냥한 것으로 보인다.)

Lawmaker Song Young-gil, at a town hall meeting for Democratic Party members in northern Gyeonggi Province held at Shinhan University in Uijeongbu, targeted Jung Cheong-rae, saying, “Looking at the party leadership over the past year, it’s like a neighborhood brawl—staying up all night over supplementary investigation powers, and now staying up all night over the one-person-one-vote system. All of our party’s focus should be on whether these issues help in re-creating the next government and winning the general election.” He continued, “Jung Cheong-rae’s leadership, during the June 3 local elections, claimed that holding primaries everywhere was akin to democracy. Especially during the primary process in the Honam region, they only caused emotions to pile up among party members, destroying competitiveness before even reaching the main election. It was a foolish act.” He added, “Claiming this is democracy is an irresponsible exercise of leadership.” (송영길 의원은 이날 경기 의정부시 신한대에서 열린 경기북부 민주당원 타운홀미팅에서 정 전 대표를 향해 “지난 1년 당 지도부의 모습을 보면 맨 동네 싸움에, 보완수사권을 가지고 밤 새우고, 지금은 1인1표제를 갖고 밤을 새우고 있는데, 지금 우리 당의 모든 중심은 이런 문제가 차기 정권재창출과 총선 승리에 도움이 되는가 안 되는가에 있어야 한다”고 말했다. 이어 “정청래 지도부가 (6·3지방선거 때) 모든 곳을 경선을 한다고, 그것이 마치 민주주의인 것처럼 표방했다. 특히 호남 지역 경선 과정에서 당원들끼리 서로 감정만 쌓이게 만들어 본선에 가기도 전에 경쟁력을 무너뜨리는 무식한 짓을 했다”며 “이게 민주주의라고 떠드는 건 지도력의 무책임한 짓이라고 본다”고 했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Seok-yeon, Presidential Committee on National Unity Chairman: "Complete Abolition of Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigative Powers is Unconstitutional" (이석연 통합위원장 “검찰 보완수사권 완전 폐지는 헌법 위배”)
item.description:
Lee Seok-yeon, chairman of the Presidential Committee on National Unity, stated on the 12th, "The complete abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers is a violation of the Constitution." (이석연 대통령 직속 국민통합위원장은 12일 “검사의 보완수사권 완전 폐지는 헌법에 위배된다”고 밝혔다.)

In a post on his Facebook page that day, Chairman Lee said, "Not only from the perspective of victim protection, discovery of substantive truth, and swift realization of justice in criminal law, but also to uphold the spirit of the Constitution, the prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers must be recognized in some form." (이 위원장은 이날 자신의 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “피해자 보호, 실체적 진실 발견, 형사사법의 신속한 정의 실현이라는 차원에서 뿐만 아니라, 헌법의 정신을 지키기 위해서도 검사의 보완수사권은 어떤 형태로든지 인정되어야 한다”며 이렇게 밝혔다.)

He argued, "Although the Constitution does not prevent the abolition of the prosecution's office to disperse prosecutors' authority, completely stripping prosecutors, as the subjects of investigation, of their investigative powers goes against the principle of constitutional systematic legitimacy and carries the risk of unconstitutionality. To completely eliminate prosecutors' investigative powers, the Constitution must be amended, changing the authority to request warrants from prosecutors to investigative agencies, as in the original Constitution, or it must be delegated to law." (그는 “헌법은 비록 검찰청을 폐지하여 검사의 권한을 분산하는 것까지는 막고 있지 않지만, 수사의 주체로서의 검사가 가진 수사권의 완전 박탈은 헌법의 체계정당성의 원리에 반하여 위헌의 소지가 있다”며 “검사의 수사권을 완전 박탈하기 위해서는 헌법을 개정하여 제헌헌법처럼 영장신청권을 검사 대신 수사기관으로 고치든지 아니면 법률에 위임해야 한다”고 주장했다.)

Chairman Lee also directed remarks at the Democratic Party of Korea, saying, "As a responsible political party, it should not abandon the basic principles for the future of the community in the name of reform by clinging to immediate supporter sentiments or party interests." He continued, "The system itself has no inherent good or evil. Regardless of the system, it's a problem of the people operating it," and added, "I sincerely hope that the urgent issues of our society, which are heading toward severe national division, are discussed and resolved based on legal stability and predictability, in accordance with the Constitution and sound public common sense." (이 위원장은 더불어민주당을 향해 “책임 있는 공당이라면 당장의 지지층의 눈치나 당리당략에 매달려 개혁이라는 이름으로 공동체의 미래를 위한 기본원칙을 저버려서는 안 된다”고 했다. 이어 “제도 그 자체는 선악이 없다. 어떤 제도가 됐던 그 제도를 운영하는 사람의 문제”라며 “심각한 국론 분열로 치닫고 있는 우리 사회의 현안들이 법적 안정성과 예측가능성을 바탕으로 헌법과 건전한 국민상식에 따라 논의되고 해결되기를 간절히 기대한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Government Requests North Korea's Cooperation in Search for Missing Navy Sailor… "Possible Drift Across NLL" ([속보] 정부, 북한에 ‘실종 해군’ 수색 협조 요청…“NLL 표류 가능성”)
item.description:
A sailor from a Navy vessel on patrol near the Northern Limit Line (NLL) in the East Sea went missing on the 12th. (동해 북방한계선(NLL) 인근 해상에서 경계 임무를 수행하던 해군 함정 승조원 1명이 12일 실종됐다.)

The Navy stated, "The sailor went missing this morning in the sea about 50 km east of Geojin, in the East Sea," and added, "We are conducting a joint search with the Coast Guard, deploying around 10 ships and multiple available aircraft to locate the missing individual. We have also notified fishing vessels and nearby commercial ships of the situation and requested their cooperation in the search." (해군은 “이날 오전 동해 거진 동방 50여㎞ 해상에서 승조원이 실종됐다”며 “해경과 합동으로 함정 10여척 및 운용 가능한 항공기 여러대를 투입해 실종자를 찾고 있다. 조업 중인 어선, 인근 상선 등에도 상황을 전파하고 수색을 협조하고 있다”고 했다.)

The missing sailor is reported to be a Private First Class aboard a frigate. The Navy became aware of the disappearance around 7:45 a.m. when the soldier failed to appear for his shift at the duty station. The last sighting of the missing sailor was by a duty officer who conducted a ship interior patrol between midnight and 2 a.m.; the sailor is said to have been on regular duty the previous day. (실종된 병사는 호위함에 승선한 일병으로 알려졌다. 해군은 이날 아침 7시45분께 해당 병사가 근무해야 할 당직교대실에 나타나지 않아 실종 사실을 인지했다. 이날 자정에서 새벽 2시 사이 함내를 순찰하던 당직자가 실종 병사를 마지막으로 목격했으며, 전날엔 정상 근무를 섰다고 한다.)

Considering that the estimated location of the missing individual is east of Goseong County, Gangwon Province, the Joint Chiefs of Staff notified North Korea of the search situation via the International Merchant Ship Common Network. The Ministry of Unification also requested of North Korea, "There is a possibility that the missing person may have drifted north of the Northern Limit Line," and stated, "Our Navy is currently searching for the missing individual. We ask for your cooperation in the search and repatriation of the missing person from a humanitarian perspective." (합동참모본부는 실종자 추정 위치가 강원도 고성군 동쪽 해상인 점을 고려해 국제상선공통망을 통해 북한에도 실종 수색 상황을 알렸다. 통일부도 북한에 “(실종자가) 북방한계선 이북 지역으로 표류할 가능성이 있는 것으로 보인다”며 “현재 우리 해군이 실종자를 탐색 중인바, 인도주의적 견지에서 실종자 수색과 송환에 협조해주기를 요청한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: On Growth Rebound Signs, "Early Phase Where Long-Term Trend May Change" (김용범, 성장률 반등 조짐에 “장기 추세 달라질 초기 국면”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom, head of the presidential office's policy division, stated regarding signs of a rebound in South Korea's economic growth rate this year: "This should be seen as an early phase indicating not just a simple economic recovery, but the possibility of the long-term trend itself changing." (김용범 청와대 정책실장이 올해 한국 경제성장률이 반등 조짐을 보이는 것과 관련해 “단순한 경기 회복이 아니라 장기 추세 자체가 달라질 가능성을 보여주는 초기 국면으로 읽어야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

In a Facebook post on the 12th, Director Kim said, "The magnitude of upward revisions in growth forecasts, the speed of capital market revaluation, and the intensity of the interplay between policy and industrial cycles are at levels rarely seen in the South Korean economy over recent decades." He attributed this to the resolution of political uncertainty following the new administration's launch and the clarification of policy directions, combined with the entry into a semiconductor super-cycle triggered by AI, which together structurally reversed the economic growth trend starting in the second half of last year. The International Monetary Fund (IMF) had previously raised its economic growth forecast for this year to 2.6%, up 0.7 percentage points from its April forecast of 1.9%. (김 실장은 12일 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “성장률 전망의 상향폭, 자본시장 재평가의 속도, 정책과 산업 사이클이 맞물린 강도는 최근 수십년 한국 경제에서 쉽게 찾아보기 어려운 수준”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 새정부 출범에 따른 정치적 불확실성 수습 및 정책 방향 정리와 에이아이(AI)가 촉발한 반도체 슈퍼사이클 진입이 맞물려 지난해 하반기부터 경제 성장 추세가 구조적으로 반전됐다는 것이다. 앞서 국제통화기금(IMF)은 올해 경제성장률 전망치를 4월 전망치(1.9%)보다 0.7%포인트 높은 2.6%로 상향한 바 있다.)

Director Kim said, "In economic history, periods when policy and industrial cycles move in the same direction are rare," adding, "Usually, policy goes against the cycle, or the cycle overwhelms policy. Moments when these two forces amplify each other are uncommon, but it appears that South Korea in the second half of 2025 has entered such a phase." He continued, "Until very recently, there was a strong perception that low growth at around 1% was the new normal for the Korean economy. But now, a growth rate in the high 2% range is being discussed as a realistic forecast, and discussions have begun that even the recovery of a potential growth rate of 3%, which once sounded unrealistic, is not entirely out of reach as a goal." He added, "What's important is not the number itself. It's the fact that a growth trajectory once deemed impossible has re-entered the scope of policy and market discussions." (김 실장은 “경제사에서 정책과 산업 사이클이 같은 방향으로 움직이는 시기는 드물다”며 “대개는 정책이 사이클을 거스르거나 사이클이 정책을 압도한다. 두 힘이 서로를 증폭시키는 순간은 흔치 않은데, 2025년 하반기의 한국이 그런 구간에 들어선 것으로 보인다”고 했다. 이어 “불과 얼마 전까지만 해도 한국 경제는 1%대 저성장이 뉴노멀이라는 인식이 강했다. 그런데 이제는 2% 후반의 성장률이 현실적인 전망으로 거론되고, 한동안 비현실적으로 들리던 잠재성장률 3% 회복까지도 완전히 손닿지 않는 목표만은 아니라는 논의가 나오기 시작했다”며 “중요한 것은 숫자 자체가 아니다. 불가능하다고 여겨졌던 성장경로가 다시 정책과 시장의 논의 안으로 들어왔다는 사실”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding the rebound in economic growth, Director Kim said, "Semiconductors are just the starting point; the real change lies in the fact that the expansion of production capacity and the assetization of production outcomes have begun to be promoted simultaneously," citing the three mega-projects and the government's capital market reform measures in tandem. He explained, "The three mega-projects centered on semiconductors, AI data centers, and physical AI are bold industrial policies aimed at elevating the very production capacity of the Korean economy to the next level." He added, "The revision of the Commercial Act, the expansion of directors' duty of loyalty to shareholders, the reform of the treasury stock system, the National Growth Fund, and the shift to productive finance are efforts to ensure that the outcomes of increased production do not remain confined within companies but circulate positively through corporate value and national assets back into future industrial investment." He stated, "If one is about enlarging the engine's size, the other is about fixing the system to transmit that power throughout the entire economy." (김 실장은 경제성장률 반등과 관련해 “반도체는 출발점일 뿐, 진짜 변화는 생산능력의 확대와 생산 성과의 자산화가 동시에 추진되기 시작했다는 데 있다”며 3대 메가프로젝트와 정부의 자본시장 개혁 조처를 나란히 언급했다. 그는 “반도체와 에이아이 데이터센터, 피지컬 에이아이를 축으로 한 3대 메가프로젝트는 한국 경제의 생산능력 자체를 한 단계 더 끌어올리려는 담대한 산업정책”이라며 “상법 개정, 이사의 주주 충실의무 확대, 자사주 제도 개편, 국민성장펀드, 생산적 금융으로의 전환은 그렇게 늘어난 생산의 성과가 기업 내부에만 머물지 않고 기업가치와 국민자산을 거쳐 다시 미래 산업 투자로 선순환하게 만드는 작업”이라고 설명했다. 이어 “하나가 엔진의 크기를 키우는 일이라면, 다른 하나는 그 힘을 경제 전체로 전달하는 체계를 고치는 일”이라고 했다.)

Director Kim also acknowledged limitations, saying, "Of course, we are still at the beginning," noting, "Low birth rates, aging, and household debt remain unresolved. The won's status must also be elevated further, and dependence on AI and semiconductors is a task that needs to be managed." Nevertheless, he remarked, "But the fact that structural problems persist and the fact that the growth trajectory is shifting can both be true at the same time," adding, "If the AI production revolution and capital market reforms work together, and if the three mega-projects once again boost production capacity itself, South Korea could transform from a country that most faithfully followed Japan's path into the first country to break away from it." (김 실장은 “물론 아직 초입”이라며 “저출산과 고령화, 가계부채는 그대로 남아있다. 원화의 위상도 더 높아져야 하고, 에이아이와 반도체 의존도 역시 관리해야 할 과제”라고 한계점을 거론하기도 했다. 그러면서도 “하지만 구조적 문제가 남아 있다는 사실과 성장경로가 뒤바뀌고 있다는 사실은 얼마든지 동시에 성립한다”라며 “에이아이 생산혁명과 자본시장 개혁이 함께 작동하고, 3대 메가 프로젝트가 생산능력 자체를 다시 끌어올린다면 한국은 일본의 길을 가장 충실히 따라온 나라에서, 그 길을 가장 먼저 벗어나는 나라가 될 수도 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Koh Min-jung: "If Problems Arise After Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Rights, Then Supplement? That's Not the Stance of a Ruling Party" (고민정 “보완수사권 폐지 뒤 문제 생기면 보완?…집권당 자세 아냐”)
item.description:
Koh Min-jung, a lawmaker running in the Democratic Party of Korea's leadership election, stated on the 12th regarding the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights: "While opposing abolition, which most Democratic Party members support, may not be politically expedient, taking a stance of 'let's abolish it first and fix problems later' is not the posture of a ruling party. We must engage in responsible politics, not just a competition of clarity or ideological righteousness." (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 나선 고민정 의원이 12일 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 여부와 관련해 “민주당원 다수가 찬성하는 보완수사권 폐지에 반대하는 게 정치적 계산에는 맞지 않지만, 일단 검찰 보완수사권을 폐지하고 문제가 생기면 보완하자는 것은 집권여당의 자세가 아니다”라며 “선명성 경쟁, 이념적 당위에만 머무르는 게 아니라 책임정치를 해야 한다”고 말했다.)

During a policy speech at the KDLC (National Autonomy and Decentralization Democratic Leadership Council) meeting held at the National Assembly Member's Office Building, Koh said: "If I were a victim of sexual assault, I question whether I could logically explain to the prosecution to request supplementary investigation. For cases involving social minorities, such as sexual violence crimes or disabled victims, another investigative body should cross-check." (고 의원은 이날 국회 의원회관에서 열린 민주당 전국자치분권민주지도자회의(KDLC) 당대표 후보 정견발표에서 “내가 성폭행 피해자라면 검찰에 (보완)수사요구를 해달라고 논리적으로 설명할 수 있을까라는 의문이 해결되지 않는다”며 “성폭력 범죄나 장애인 등 사회적 약자가 피해자가 되는 경우에 한해 또다른 수사기관이 크로스체크를 해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Koh addressed former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok: "When the Prosecution Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office decided to abolish supplementary investigation rights, what supplementary measures were considered? How will we address blind spots in investigations of everyday crimes like sexual violence?" She also asked former party leader Chung Cheong-rae: "If complete abolition of supplementary investigation rights is not merely a political slogan, what alternatives do you have for public concerns regarding cases involving social minorities?" (고 의원은 김민석 전 총리를 향해 “총리실 산하 검찰개혁추진단에서 보완수사권 폐지를 결정하며 어떤 보완책을 고민했냐. 성폭력 범죄 등 민생범죄 수사 사각지대를 어떻게 보완할 것이냐”고 물었다. 정청래 전 대표에게도 “보완수사권 완전 폐지가 정치적 구호에 그치는 게 아니라면 사회적 약자 사건에 대한 국민들의 우려에 어떤 대안이 있느냐”고 물었다.)

Earlier, lawyer-turned-lawmaker Lee So-young also posted on Facebook under the title "Expressing Concerns Over Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Rights," pointing out that under the bill proposed by the party's Criminal Procedure Act Revision Task Force (TF) on the 9th, concerns remain: prosecutors must decide whether to indict based solely on documents submitted by the police, and reduced detention periods make it difficult to indict within the timeframe. (앞서, 변호사 출신 이소영 의원도 이날 자신의 페이스북에 ‘보완수사권 폐지에 우려를 표한다’ 제목의 글을 올려, 지난 9일 당 형사소송법 개정 태스크포스(TF)가 내놓은 법안대로라면 △경찰이 작성해 넘긴 서류만을 보고 기소 여부를 판단해야 하는 점 △구속기간을 줄여 기한 내에 기소하기 어려운 점 등이 우려된다고 지적했다.)

Lee stated: "The sole argument from those advocating complete abolition is mistrust—'the prosecution cannot be trusted'—while the party's TF claims it can be resolved through 'substantialization of the right to request supplementary investigations.' However, no concrete explanation has been provided on how these issues can actually be resolved." She added: "To prevent distortion of discussions due to internal party elections, it is reasonable to discuss calmly and make decisions after the elections." (이 의원은 “완전 폐지를 주장하는 분들의 유일한 논거는 ‘검찰을 믿을 수 없다’는 불신이고, 당 티에프는 ‘보완수사요구권 실질화’로 해결할 수 있다고 하지만, 이런 문제가 어떻게 해결될 수 있다는 것인지 구체적 설명은 제시되지 않고 있다”고 했다. 이어 ““당내 선거로 인한 논의 왜곡이 일어나지 않도록, 차분히 논의하고 선거 이후 결정을 내리는 것이 합당하다”고 했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun: jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 65th Anniversary of North Korea-China Friendship Treaty… Both Premiers Call for Expanded Economic Cooperation and Exchanges (북중 우호조약 65돌…양국 총리 “경제협력·교류 확대”)
item.description:
Pak Thae-song, Premier of the North Korean Cabinet, who visited China to commemorate the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance (North Korea-China Friendship Treaty), met with both Chinese President Xi Jinping and Chinese Premier Li Qiang, concluding his three-day visit to China on the 12th. Going forward, China is expected to strengthen its influence on the Korean Peninsula in North Korea-China relations, while North Korea will focus on leveraging this to secure practical benefits in areas such as economy and trade. (북중 우호협력 및 상호원조조약(북중 우호조약) 체결 65주년을 기념해 중국을 방문한 박태성 북한 내각총리가 시진핑 중국국가주석과 리창 중국 국무원 총리를 모두 만나고 2박3일간의 방중 일정을 12일 마무리했다. 앞으로 북중관계에서 중국은 한반도에서의 영향력을 강화하고 북한은 이를 지렛대 삼아 경제·무역 등에서 실리를 챙기는 데에 집중할 것으로 보인다.)

The Korean Central News Agency reported on this day that Premier Pak Thae-song and Chinese Premier Li Qiang held talks the previous day, where they discussed "matters related to expanding and developing exchanges and cooperation in various fields in accordance with the agreements reached by the top leaders of the DPRK and China at their historic meeting in Pyongyang." China's Xinhua News Agency also reported that during the talks, Premier Li said, "China hopes to align development strategies with the DPRK (North Korea), steadily expand economic and trade exchanges, and deepen cooperation in areas such as transportation network connectivity, healthcare, education, and other livelihood sectors." The North Korean delegation received a warm welcome, with Premier Pak and Premier Li jointly reviewing an honor guard. <<> Since arriving in Beijing on the 10th, Premier Pak has met with President Xi Jinping and Zhao Leji, the third-ranking official in China and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, receiving treatment befitting a state guest. The successive meetings between China's top leadership and Premier Pak are interpreted as a move to implement the agreements reached at last month's North Korea-China summit. Issues such as group tourism by Chinese citizens to areas like the Wonsan Kalma District and the opening of the new Yalu River Bridge are believed to have been discussed. <<> Chinese media reported that during his meeting with Premier Li, Premier Pak stated that North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un "demanded the development of the DPRK-China (North Korea-China) relationship into the strongest strategic relationship," and that North Korea firmly supports safeguarding China's core interests, including the Taiwan issue. However, North Korea did not report these remarks. <<> Chairman Kim and President Xi also exchanged congratulatory messages, strengthening strategic communication. Chairman Kim stated, "The DPRK-China friendly and cooperative relationship is being elevated and developed to a new strategic height today, making significant contributions to firmly safeguarding the sovereignty, security, and development interests of both countries amid the complex and volatile international situation, as well as to protecting regional and global peace and stability." President Xi also said, "The firm resolve to safeguard the interests of both China and the DPRK and a favorable strategic environment will remain unchanged." <<> China also put effort into the ceremony to commemorate the signing of the North Korea-China Friendship Treaty. At the commemorative banquet held at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse in Beijing on the 10th, Cai Qi, the fifth-ranking official and a member of the Secretariat of the Central Committee, attended to welcome Premier Pak. At the 50th anniversary commemorative banquet of the Friendship Treaty in 2011, Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Jiang Shusheng attended as the Chinese representative, who is lower in rank than a member of the Standing Committee. No banquets were held in 2016 (55th anniversary) or 2021 (60th anniversary). <<> Jeong Jae-heung, a senior research fellow at the Sejong Institute, said, "Since the Cabinet Premier, who oversees the external economy, has visited China, it seems that more discussions will take place on North Korea-China economic exchange and cooperation," adding, "North Korea's geopolitical importance is also growing, so the North Korea-China relationship is expected to become even closer in the future." <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr, Beijing Correspondent Lee Jeong-yeon xingxing@hani.co.kr (조선중앙통신은 박태성 총리와 리창 중국 국무원 총리가 전날 회담해 “조중 최고수뇌분들께서 역사적인 평양 상봉에서 이룩하신 합의에 따라 각 분야에서 교류와 협력을 확대, 발전시켜 나가기 위한 문제들이 토의되었다”고 이날 보도했다. 중국 신화통신도 회담에서 리창 총리가 “중국은 조선(북한)과 발전 전략을 연계하고, 경제·무역 왕래를 안정적으로 확대하며 교통망 연결, 보건·교육 등 민생 분야 협력을 심화하자”고 말했다고 전했다. 박 총리는 리 총리와 함께 의장대를 사열하는 등 북한 대표단은 환대를 받았다.)

item.title: Democratic Party's 'Preferential Voting System' in Stalemate… Could Internal Strife Between Pro-Myung and Pro-Cheong Prolong (민주 ‘선호투표제’ 평행선…친명·친청 내홍 장기화되나)
item.description:
The conflict within the Democratic Party of Korea over whether to introduce a 'preferential voting system' and a 'youth supreme council member system' for the August 17 party convention leadership election is prolonged. As the party's supreme council runs on parallel lines of approval and opposition, if it fails to reach an agreement and resorts to a vote, there are predictions that the aftermath could be significant regardless of how the final primary method is decided. <<> Former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, who opposes the introduction of the preferential voting system, shared a cartoon from a media outlet on Facebook on the 12th, writing, "It hurts a lot when you get hit. I'll try to endure well." The preferential voting system is a method where voters list the three finalists in order of preference, and if no candidate receives a majority, the votes of those who ranked the lowest vote-getter first are reallocated to their second choice to determine the final winner. Jeong's camp sees the 'anti-Jeong Cheong-rae' alliance between former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil as solid, making the preferential voting system disadvantageous for them. Jeong's camp also opposes the decision made by the party convention preparation committee on the 7th to elect one of the five elected supreme council members as a youth, citing the timing close to the candidate registration period (16th-17th). <<> In response, lawmaker Song wrote on Facebook, "Stopping the party's procedures based on the advantages or disadvantages of a specific candidate—that is a denial of party members' sovereignty. I request the supreme council: please judge from the party members' perspective." According to the preparation committee's decision, the supreme council should decide on implementing the preferential voting system and the youth supreme council member system, then pass it on to the next decision-making body, the party affairs committee. The party affairs committee is reportedly set to meet on the 13th. Former Prime Minister Kim also posted on X (formerly Twitter) the previous day, stating, "It should not go beyond this weekend. The supreme council should expedite handling the preparation committee's resolutions. Only then can the party convention proceed normally." A Democratic Party official said, "Conflicts over party convention rules have occurred frequently in the past, but they were ultimately resolved through political compromise. If the supreme council, which discusses convention rules, has each candidate's representatives lined up, and they decide the final rules by vote, the foundation collapses." Another first-term lawmaker added, "Even now, internal strife among supporters is reaching dangerous levels. If we decide convention rules by vote, the conflict will only spread further." Currently, four out of the seven supreme council members (Lee Seong-yoon, Moon Jung-bok, Park Ji-won, and Park Gyu-hwan) are classified as aligned with Jeong's camp. <<> Pressure has also mounted on the supreme council members aligned with Jeong to resign. Lawmaker Yeom Tae-young, who assists former Prime Minister Kim, wrote on Facebook the previous day, "The appointed supreme council members should resign, and supreme council members running for party positions should also step down." This targeted Park Ji-won, Park Gyu-hwan, and Lee Seong-yoon, respectively. In response, Supreme Council member Park Gyu-hwan retorted, "If the three appointed supreme council members (Park Ji-won and Park Gyu-hwan) and Lee Seong-yoon resign, the total quorum (9 members) would be reduced, crippling the supreme council's function. Are you suggesting we push the party, which is fine, into a quagmire?" <<> Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에 ‘선호투표제’와 ‘청년 최고위원제’를 도입할지를 두고 더불어민주당 내 대립이 장기화하고 있다. 찬반 평행선을 달리는 민주당 최고위원회의가 합의에 도달하지 못하고 표결에 나설 경우, 최종 경선 방식이 어떻게 결정되든 후폭풍이 적지 않을 것이란 전망이 나온다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk’s Nationwide Tour for “Only By-elections”… Inside the Party, Cold Response: “A Move That Fails to Garner Sympathy” (장동혁 “재선거뿐” 전국 순회…당내선 “공감 못 얻는 행보” 냉담)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, is immersed in “out-of-parliament politics” demanding by-elections for the June 3 local elections. Criticism arises both within and outside the party that this move “fails to gain sympathy.” (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 6·3 지방선거 재선거를 요구하는 ‘장외 정치’에 몰두하고 있다. 당 안팎에서는 이런 행보가 “공감을 얻지 못하고 있다”는 비판이 나온다.)

At the “June 3 Disenfranchisement Incident Busan-South Gyeongsang Area Youth and College Student On-Site Meeting” held at the People Power Party’s Busan city party office in Suyeong-gu, Busan, on the 12th, Leader Jang stated, “The only way to reclaim a lost vote is through a by-election,” and added, “Let’s abolish the early voting system and conduct only regular voting.” Afterward, Jang appeared at a protest rally against infringement of voting rights held at Seomyeon Heart Plaza in Busanjin-gu. This marks his second out-of-parliament schedule following a rally in Incheon on the 8th. Jang is also coordinating attendance at rallies scheduled in Gwangju and Daegu. (장 대표는 12일 부산시 수영구 국민의힘 부산시당에서 열린 ‘6·3 참정권 박탈 사태 부산·경남권 청년·대학생 현장 간담회’에서 “잃어버린 한 표를 찾는 방법은 재선거밖에 없다”면서 “사전투표제를 폐지하고 본투표만 실시하자”고 말했다. 장 대표는 이후 부산진구 서면 하트광장에서 열린 참정권 침해 규탄 집회에도 얼굴을 비쳤다. 지난 8일 인천 집회에 이어 두번째 장외 일정이다. 장 대표는 광주와 대구에서 열리는 집회 참석 일정도 조율 중이다.)

Within the People Power Party, voices point out Leader Jang’s neglect of parliamentary activities. A first-term lawmaker from the Yeongnam region said in a phone call with the Hankyoreh on the same day, “As the ruling and opposition parties are clashing over the abolition of the supplementary investigation power, it’s time to focus on parliamentary struggles,” and added, “National by-elections aren’t gaining any sympathy from lawmakers either.” Another first-term lawmaker commented, “We need to find a reasonable solution (regarding the disenfranchisement incident), but Leader Jang can’t solve this by just staying outside.” Kim Moo-sung, a conservative elder and former leader of the Saenuri Party, appeared on TV Chosun the previous day and said, “The party leader is going outside because there’s no place for him within the party.” (국민의힘 내부에선 원내를 버려둔 장 대표 행보를 지적하는 목소리가 나온다. 영남권 한 초선 의원은 이날 한겨레와 한 통화에서 “여야가 보완수사권 폐지 문제를 놓고 대립하고 있는 만큼 원내 투쟁에 집중할 때”라며 “전국 재선거도 의원들의 공감을 전혀 얻지 못하고 있다”고 했다. 다른 초선 의원도 “(참정권 침해 사태와 관련해) 합리적인 해법을 찾아야 하는데 장 대표가 계속 외부로만 다녀서 될 문제가 아니다”라고 했다. 보수 원로인 김무성 전 새누리당 대표는 전날 티브이(TV)조선에 출연해 “당대표가 당에 설 자리가 없으니까 장외로 도는 것”이라고 했다.)

Controversy is also brewing over Leader Jang’s participation in the “vote-counting site blockade protest” at Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul, on the 11th, where he directly targeted President Lee Jae-myung, shaking a handheld placard written in casual language saying, “Jae-myung, did you see that?” On the 7th, he also held a placard reading, “Jae-myung, fight me, not high school students.” This has drawn criticism from within the People Power Party, including remarks such as “the excrement of far-right extremists going wild” (from Kim Geun-sik, chair of the Songpa B district party committee) and “an insulting nickname” (from former spokesperson Yoon Hee-seok). (장 대표가 지난 11일 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 ‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’에 참석해 이재명 대통령을 직격하며 반말로 ‘재명아 봤지?’라고 적힌 손팻말을 흔든 것을 두고도 논란이 일고 있다. 그는 지난 7일에도 ‘재명아 고등학생 말고 나랑 싸우자’라는 손팻말을 들었다. 이를 두고 국민의힘 내부에서도 “극우 막가파들의 배설”(김근식 송파병 당협위원장), “멸칭”(윤희석 전 대변인) 등의 비판이 나왔다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr 유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Leadership Contenders Present Policy Visions at Joint Event, Supporters Clash with Shouting and Physical Altercations (민주 당권주자들 한자리서 정견발표…지지자들 고함·몸싸움)
item.description:
Leading candidates for the Democratic Party of Korea's leadership escalated tensions ahead of the August 17 national convention during their first joint policy presentation event on the 12th, launching sharp attacks against one another. The venue saw physical scuffles and shouting matches among supporters of each candidate, repeatedly exposing the overheated atmosphere of the convention. (더불어민주당 유력 당권 주자들이 12일 첫 정견발표 행사에서 서로를 향해 날 선 공세를 내놓는 등 8·17 전당대회 긴장 수위가 높아지고 있다. 행사장에선 각 후보 지지자 간 몸싸움이 벌어지고 고성이 오가는 등 크고 작은 충돌도 발생해 전당대회 과열 양상이 고스란히 드러났다.)

The event, organized by the Democratic Party's National Autonomy and Decentralization Democratic Leadership Council (KDLC) and held at the National Assembly lawmakers' office building, was attended by all major leadership contenders, including former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, lawmakers Song Young-gil and Ko Min-jung, and former Chairwoman of Gangjin County Council Kim Bo-mi. This marked the first time all leadership hopefuls gathered together since the convention phase began in earnest. The KDLC is an assembly of Democratic Party-affiliated local government heads, provincial and metropolitan councilors, and basic council members. <<> Former PM Kim emphasized, "Without victory in the 2028 general election, there will be no reform, no growth of local autonomy, and no success for the Lee Jae-myung administration. I will surely lead us to victory." During a later Q&A session with YouTubers titled "Baekmun Baekdap with Kim Min-seok," he also stated, "The party leadership must undoubtedly be changed." In that session, Kim presented a medical certificate and pharmacy prescription from December 3, 2024, actively refuting attacks from Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon, an ally of former leader Jeong, over his absence from the vote to lift martial law in the National Assembly. <<> Former leader Jeong remarked at the KDLC event, "Those who have declared their candidacies are all attacking and criticizing me, and it hurts a lot. Fighting two against one or three against one is unfair. As a former party leader, I am willing to take what I deserve, but I will exercise self-defense." This highlighted his perception of being subjected to a "pincer attack" from former PM Kim and Lawmaker Song. Jeong also stated, "Leaving the party during an election, helping another party's candidate, and running as an independent—that is the worst form of self-serving politics." This was a direct reference to former PM Kim leaving the party in 2002 to join the National Unity 21 party led by candidate Chung Mong-joon during that year's presidential election. <<> Lawmaker Song criticized former leader Jeong, saying, "The ruling party must take responsibility for all outcomes. The Democratic Party I envision is not a neighborhood party fighting against the People Power Party, but a global party dedicated to safeguarding the Republic of Korea's sovereignty and protecting national interests worldwide." At a "Gyeonggi Northern Town Hall Meeting" held in Uijeongbu, Gyeonggi Province the same day, Song sharpened his tone, stating, "The Jeong Cheong-rae leadership made the mistake of framing the primary process (during the June 3 local elections) as if it were democracy itself. Causing a candidate to be wounded during the primary, destroying their competitiveness for the general election—that was an ignorant act. Calling it democracy is an abdication of leadership and irresponsibility." <<> Lawmaker Ko questioned former PM Kim and former leader Jeong, asking, "What supplementary measures have you considered regarding the abolition of supplementary investigative powers? What alternatives do you have to address public concerns over cases involving socially vulnerable groups, such as sexual violence crimes?" Former Chairwoman Kim Bo-mi, in her 30s, remarked, "All three leadership candidates who have declared their intentions are from the 386 generation. Shouldn't we move on to a graceful farewell rather than going all the way to 786 or 886?" <<> The overheated atmosphere of the convention was fully on display at the event venue. <<> As former leader Jeong entered the venue, some party members shouted, "Jeong Cheong-rae, resign!" and "Stop dividing us!" Some continued shouting throughout Jeong's speech, causing him to pause twice. After the event ended, chaos ensued as a bystander used a placard to cover the mouth of a person shouting criticism at Jeong, leading to a physical altercation. <<> Reporter Ko Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr ( 이날 국회 의원회관에서 열린 민주당 전국자치분권민주지도자회의(KDLC) 당대표 후보 정견발표 행사에는 김민석 전 국무총리와 정청래 전 대표, 송영길·고민정 의원, 김보미 전 강진군의회 의장 등 당권 주자들이 모두 참석했다. 전당대회 국면이 본격화한 뒤 당권 주자들이 모두 한자리에 모인 것은 처음이다. 전국자치분권민주지도자회의는 민주당 소속 기초단체장과 광역의원, 기초의원 등이 모인 모임이다.)

item.title: Election Commission Operates Hundreds of Billions in 'Commissioned Election' Funds Without Budget or Settlement (선관위, 예·결산 없이 ‘위탁선거’ 대금 수백억 운용)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC) has been managing funds amounting to hundreds of millions to tens of billions of won related to commissioned elections without including them in the budget and settlement accounts, leading to a demand for correction from the National Assembly. (선거관리위원회가 수억~수백억에 달하는 위탁선거 관련 대금을 예·결산에 포함시키지 않고 운용해오다 국회의 시정요구를 받았다.)

According to the 2025 Settlement Analysis Report published by the National Assembly Budget Office (NABO) on the 10th, the NEC was commissioned to handle 1,190 elections for various public organizations, including the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation (Nonghyup), the National Federation of Fisheries Cooperatives (Suhyup), and the Forestry Cooperatives, last year, executing 22.439 billion won. However, in the settlement statement, it recorded only 128 million won as executed. The NABO stated that the NEC also executed funds without including them in the budget and settlement accounts in 2024 (700 million won), 2023 (34.002 billion won), 2022 (2.387 billion won), and 2021 (908 million won). (국회예산정책처(예정처)가 지난 10일 발간한 2025년 결산분석 보고서를 보면, 선관위는 지난해 농협·수협·산림조합 등 각종 공공단체의 선거 1190건을 위탁받아 224억3900만원을 집행했지만 결산서에는 1억2800만원만 집행했다고 기록했다. 선관위는 2024년에도 7억원, 2023년 340억200만원, 2022년 23억8700만원, 2021년 9억800만원 등을 예·결산에 포함하지 않은 채 집행했다고 예정처는 밝혔다.)

The NABO pointed out, "There is a problem that most commissioned election expenses are executed without prior deliberation by the National Assembly. Since commissioned election expenses are managed outside the revenue and expenditure budget, they fall outside the scope of the National Assembly's budget and settlement review. Although the NEC submits calculation standards and settlement statements for commissioned election expenses to the relevant standing committee of the National Assembly, the level of transparency does not reach that of the revenue and expenditure budget submitted to the National Assembly and disclosed to the general public." (예정처는 “대부분 위탁선거경비가 국회의 사전 심의 없이 집행되고 있는 문제가 있다”며 “위탁선거경비가 세입·세출예산 외로 운용되다보니 국회의 예결산 심사 대상에서 벗어나 있으며, 국회 소관상임위원회에 위탁선거경비의 산출기준 및 결산서 등을 제출하고는 있으나 국회에 제출되어 일반 국민에 공개되고 있는 세입세출예산 수준의 투명성에는 미치지 못하는 측면이 있다”고 지적했다.)

The NABO added, "There have also been cases, as revealed in the NEC's own audits, where expenses for commissioned elections were executed without proper reporting or approval procedures, or where payment resolution documents were falsified or fabricated." The Chungbuk Provincial Election Commission was found to have executed over 23 billion won in commissioned election expenses without proper reporting or approval procedures, discovered during an audit by the National Election Commission last year. The NABO stated to the NEC, "Rather than establishing separate legal grounds for managing commissioned election expenses outside revenue and expenditure, it is necessary to operate them as income-replacement expenses or similar, so that they are included in the national finances." (예정처는 또 “위탁선거에 쓰는 경비를 정당한 보고나 결재 절차 없이 집행하거나 지급결의서를 변조·허위 작성하는 사례가 발생했다는 선관위 자체 감사 결과도 있었다”고 덧붙였다. 충북 선관위는 위탁 선거 경비를 정당한 보고나 결재 절차 없이 230억원 넘게 집행했다가 지난해 중앙선관위 감사에서 적발됐다. 예정처는 선관위에 “위탁 선거 경비를 세입세출 외로 운용하기 위해 별도의 법적 근거를 마련하기 보다는 국가 재정에 포함되도록 수입대체경비 등으로 운용할 필요가 있다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party's Supreme Council Spins Its Wheels over 'Convention Rules'...Pro-Cheong Faction 'Unconvinced' (‘전대 룰’ 놓고 공회전하는 민주 최고위…친청 “납득 못해”)
item.description:
The internal conflict within the Democratic Party of Korea over whether to introduce a 'preferential voting system' and a 'youth supreme council member system' for the August 17 party convention's leadership election is dragging on. Even as the Democratic Party held a supreme council meeting on the evening of the 12th, four days before the party convention candidate registration deadline, it failed to reach a conclusion amid a tense pro-con debate. (8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에 ‘선호투표제’와 ‘청년 최고위원제’를 도입할지를 두고 더불어민주당 내 대립이 장기화하고 있다. 더불어민주당은 전당대회 후보 등록일 나흘 전인 12일 저녁에도 최고위원회의를 열었지만 팽팽한 찬반 대립 속에 결론을 내지 못했다.)

The Democratic Party's supreme council meeting, held at the National Assembly at 6 p.m. that day, adjourned after about two and a half hours without reaching any decision. It is said that an amendment to the current party rules, specifying the preferential voting method for electing the party leader, was brought up as an agenda item. Article 25 of the Democratic Party's constitution states that the party leader is elected by a majority vote, with specific methods delegated to party rules. Party Rule 66 states that 'the specific method for conducting a runoff election is to be decided by the Party Convention Preparation Committee (PCPC), but finalized through resolutions of the Supreme Council and the Party Affairs Committee.' Previously, the PCPC voted to implement preferential voting as one 'method' of runoff election stipulated in the party rules. When former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae claimed this violated the party constitution and rules, it appears an amendment to the party rules was prepared. Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun told reporters, "(The amendment was proposed) to resolve controversy over leadership election regulations." <<> In response, Supreme Council member Moon Jeong-bok, aligned with former Representative Jeong, told reporters, "It is difficult to accept discussing such an important matter without a process to hear the opinions of party members," and said the meeting could not proceed further. Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yun also asked, "Isn't it right to seek party members' opinions?" Considering the candidate registration schedule for the party leader and supreme council members on the 16th and 17th, a decision on introducing preferential voting must be reached by the 14th. <<> While the Supreme Council spun its wheels, former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil, who favor the preferential voting system, and former Representative Jeong, who opposes it, continued a social media war of words. On Facebook that day, former Representative Jeong shared a political cartoon from a media outlet depicting what appeared to be a pincer attack by former Prime Minister Kim and lawmaker Song, writing, "Getting hit hurts a lot. I'll try to endure it well." The Jeong camp sees the preferential voting system as disadvantageous, given the solid 'anti-Jeong Cheong-rae' alliance between former Prime Minister Kim and lawmaker Song. Lawmaker Song criticized former Representative Jeong on Facebook, saying, "Stopping the party's procedures because of a specific candidate's advantages or disadvantages—that itself is a denial of party members' sovereignty." Former Prime Minister Kim also posted on X (formerly Twitter) the previous day, urging, "The Supreme Council should promptly process the PCPC's decisions. Only then can the party convention proceed normally." <<> Pressure also mounted, calling for the resignation of supreme council members aligned with former Representative Jeong. Lawmaker Yeom Tae-young, supporting former Prime Minister Kim, wrote on Facebook the previous day, "Appointed supreme council members should resign, and supreme council members running for party positions should also step down." This was aimed at Supreme Council members Park Ji-won, Park Kyu-hwan, and Lee Seong-yun, respectively.
